English: <<Say nothing.>>
Chinese: <<一言不发。>>

English: Ah, Prisoner XVII? Still in one piece, I see. Good, good.
Chinese: 啊,十七号囚犯?看起来还完好无损。好,好。

English: I am Inquisitor Ignavus. I have a proposition for you, Prisoner XVII. A proposition that may prove mutually beneficial.
Chinese: 我是伊格纳修斯审判官。我有个提议,十七号囚犯。一个可能对彼此都有利的提议。

English: I have been tasked with apprehending a very dangerous individual. But, on assaulting her fortress, my agents have encountered a slight setback...
Chinese: 我奉命缉拿一个非常危险的人物。但在强攻她的堡垒时,我的特工遭遇了一点小小的挫折……

English: ...They are all dead.
Chinese: ……他们全死了。

English: My superiors will not take kindly to this failure; I will be punished most severely. But, I may still have one card left to play, eh?
Chinese: 我的上级不会善罢甘休;我会受到最严厉的惩罚。不过,我手里或许还剩一张牌,嗯?

English: So, on consideration, I am not sure your crimes warrant such a harsh sentence, Prisoner XVII. In fact, I will release you, on one condition...
Chinese: 所以,经过考虑,我不确定你的罪行是否配得上如此严酷的判决,十七号囚犯。事实上,我准备释放你,只有一个条件……

English: ...you must apprehend the most dangerous outlaw in the Apostatic Union: Vela Callose.
Chinese: ……你必须缉拿叛教联盟最危险的法外之徒:薇拉·卡洛斯。

English: Ah, Prisoner XVII? Still in one piece, I see. Good, good.
Chinese: 啊,十七号囚犯?看起来还完好无损。好,好。

English: How am I supposed to do that?
Chinese: 我怎么可能做得到?

English: I'm not doing a damn thing you say.
Chinese: 你说什么我也一个字都不会照做。

English: Well, you are certainly entitled to refuse. However, I should warn you that, due to an oversight, you are three hundred days overdue an execution by prolonged torture. So, you may want to heed my offer.
Chinese: 嗯,你当然有权拒绝。不过我得提醒你,由于一个疏忽,你的延长酷刑处决已经逾期三百天了。所以,你或许该考虑考虑我的提议。

English: Now listen. Vela Callose is the leader of the Dark Star mercenary band. They are notorious for aiding cultists and god worshippers.
Chinese: 现在听着。薇拉·卡洛斯是黑星佣兵团的首领。他们以援助邪教徒和神明崇拜者而臭名昭著。

English: Our ship is docked close to their headquarters - an old fortress from the God War. My agents launched an assault one hour ago, with... limited success.
Chinese: 我们的飞船就停靠在他们的总部附近——一座神之战的古老堡垒。我的特工一小时前发起了强攻,成果……有限。

English: Simply follow in their footsteps, and succeed where they failed. My drones will provide you with advice, to guide you on your way. So... any questions?
Chinese: 你只需沿着他们的足迹,在他们失败之处取得成功。我的无人机会为你提供建议,为你引路。那么……有什么问题吗?

English: This is a godsdamn suicide mission.
Chinese: 这他妈就是自杀任务。

English: Not at all! Many of the Dark Star mercenaries have been killed in the assault; only a handful remain.
Chinese: 完全不是!许多黑星佣兵已在强攻中丧命;只剩寥寥数人。

English: My drones calculate that you have a one in four hundred and sixty five chance of success. So, worth a shot, eh?
Chinese: 我的无人机计算出你有四百六十五分之一的机会成功。所以,值得一试,嗯?

English: Who is this Vela Callose, exactly?
Chinese: 这个薇拉·卡洛斯到底是什么人?

English: She's of noble birth, would you believe. Heir to a wealthy military family in Riova.
Chinese: 你敢信,她出身高贵。里奥瓦一个富裕军事家族的继承人。

English: She was groomed by her father for command; but after the death of her mother and sister, she fled. She started preaching nonsense about some 'heaven' and managed to rally a band of thieves and brigands to her cause.
Chinese: 她父亲本把她培养成统帅;但母亲和妹妹死后,她出逃了。她开始鼓吹什么"天堂"的胡话,居然拉起了一帮盗贼和匪徒为她卖命。

English: They've been causing quite the ruckus around the fringes of Union territory, aiding and abetting cultists and god worshippers. Needless to say they must be stopped.
Chinese: 他们一直在联盟领土边缘大闹天宫,援助教唆邪教徒和神明崇拜者。不用说,必须阻止他们。

English: I'll do my best. Goodbye.
Chinese: 我会尽力。告辞。

English: Very good. I'm also giving you one of our Inquisition journals. It's been constructed with state of the art cipher magic; the pages will keep track of your status.
Chinese: 很好。我还要给你一本我们的宗教裁判所日志。它以最先进的密文魔法制成;书页会记录你的状态。

English: Oh, and a word of advice - I wouldn't try and run. This is a small island, and it's a... long way down.
Chinese: 哦,还有一句忠告——我可不建议你逃跑。这是座小岛,掉下去可是……很长的一段路。

English: Ah, back already? Would you like me to recap your mission?
Chinese: 啊,这就回来了?需要我复述一遍你的任务吗?

English: Yeah - what am I doing, again?
Chinese: 好——我又要干什么来着?

English: No need, I'll be on my way.
Chinese: 不必,我这就上路。

English: Prisoner XVII. You have been marked for temporary release. The [[High Confessor]] will see you in the central chamber.
Chinese: 十七号囚犯。你已被标记为临时释放。[[至高忏悔者]]将在中央大厅见你。

English: Do not keep her waiting.
Chinese: 别让她久等。

English: Why am I being released?
Chinese: 为什么释放我?

English: Only the High Confessor can answer that. But I calculate there is a eight in ten chance you will be granted the honour of a glorious and sanctifying death.
Chinese: 只有至高忏悔者能回答这个问题。但我计算出,有十分之八的机会,你将被赐予光荣而神圣的死亡这一殊荣。

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁?

English: I was a prisoner, like you. But the Inquisition, in its generosity, has made me so much more.
Chinese: 我曾是个囚犯,和你一样。但宗教裁判所大发慈悲,让我成为了更多。

English: Cypher magic runs through my veins. My sins have been cleansed.##I am a servant of the Inquisition, now.
Chinese: 密文魔法流淌在我的血管里。我的罪孽已被洗净。##我如今是宗教裁判所的仆人。

English: I'll get going, then.
Chinese: 那我这就走。

English: [[Damaged doors]] can be broken with a weapon.
Chinese: [[破损的门]]可以用武器砸开。

English: There's a [[Chest]] next to me. Pick up the [[sword]], then press [[Inventory]] to open your journal.##Navigate to the [[equipment panel]], and equip the sword into one of your weapon slots.
Chinese: 我旁边有一个[[箱子]].捡起[[剑]],然后按[[物品栏]]打开你的日志。##前往[[装备面板]],把剑装备到你的一个武器槽位。

English: Lastly, remember to press [[attack]] to [[unholster]] your weapon.
Chinese: 最后,记得按[[攻击]]来[[拔出]]你的武器。

English: Though this is a meagre task, I calculate there is a one in twenty chance you will somehow perish in the attempt.
Chinese: 尽管这是件微不足道的小事,我计算出仍有二十分之一的机会,你会在尝试中莫名丧命。

English: You managed to break the door. It seems the prison cell did not completely deteriorate your mind . But remember, hostile enemies will actually attack back, often using sharp objects.
Chinese: 你成功砸开了门。看来牢房还没把你的脑子完全腐蚀掉。但记住,敌对的敌人是真的会还手的,而且常用利器。

English: I calculate there is a high probability you will soon be dead.
Chinese: 我计算出你很快就会死去的概率相当高。

English: The road ahead is patrolled by [[Dark Star]] mercenaries.
Chinese: 前方的道路由[[黑星]]佣兵巡逻。

English: I strongly recommend [[sneaking]] through the mushrooms to [[avoid combat.]]
Chinese: 我强烈建议[[潜行]]穿过蘑菇丛,以[[避开战斗]]。

English: It's not that I doubt your skills, Prisoner XVII. I simply calculate a three in five chance you will die horribly.
Chinese: 并不是我怀疑你的本事,十七号囚犯。我只是计算出你有五分之三的概率会死得很惨。

English: Remember; direct conflict is usually avoidable. Be on the lookout for ways to [[sneak past tough enemies]].
Chinese: 记住;正面冲突通常可以避免。留意一切能[[绕过硬骨头敌人]]的机会。

English: Our agent is dying, but they still might be of use.## You may have to [[charm]] them to gain their trust.
Chinese: 我们的特工奄奄一息,但或许还有用处。##你可能需要[[魅惑]]他们,换取他们的信任。

English: The agent may take some convincing.##You have been a prisoner for some time.
Chinese: 那位特工可能需要点说服。##你当囚犯已经有一阵子了。

English: I can no longer smell, but there is a high probability that you emit a foul stench.
Chinese: 我已经闻不到气味了,但你有很大的概率正散发着恶臭。

English: Success relies on your [[Charm skill]], which is derived from the [[Persona]] attribute.
Chinese: 成功取决于你的[[魅惑技能]],它源自[[人格]]属性。

English: [[Inquisitor Ignavius]] is waiting for you in the nearby [[Inquisition Column]], Prisoner XVII. ##We strongly recommend speaking to him before wandering forth to your highly-probable demise.
Chinese: [[伊格纳修斯审判官]]正在附近的[[宗教裁判所圆柱]]等你,十七号囚犯。##我们强烈建议在你出门赴死(概率极高)之前,先跟他说说话。

English: This [[base camp]] was used as a staging ground by our Inquisition agents.##It was highly useful for them to [[brush up on their skills]] before they all went and got themselves slaughtered by Vela's mercenaries.
Chinese: 这座[[大本营]]曾被我们的宗教裁判所特工用作集结地。##在他们全体出发、然后被薇拉的佣兵屠杀个精光之前,这里对[[温习技能]]非常有用。

English: We would recommend using the [[training dummies]] to practise your swordplay; it may marginally increase the time between now and your inevitable demise.
Chinese: 我们建议使用[[训练桩]]来练习你的剑术;这或许能略微延长从现在到你必然的死亡之间的时间。

English: Looking for [[Inquisitor Ignavius]]? He has relocated to the Blinding Light fortress; you can find him near the High Confessor.
Chinese: 在找[[伊格纳修斯审判官]]?他已转移到炫光要塞;你可以在至高忏悔者附近找到他。

English: Are you one of the locals? <<He looks you up and down in disgust>>.##Look, just leave me be. I've failed the Inquisition. I'd rather die in peace.
Chinese: 你是本地人?<<他嫌恶地上下打量你>>。##听着,别管我。我辜负了宗教裁判所。我宁愿安安静静地死。

English: @@ I'm here to help. Your Inquisitor has tasked me with capturing Vela Callose.
Chinese: @@我是来帮忙的。你的审判官派我来抓薇拉·卡洛斯。

English: %%<<He lets out a weary chuckle that breaks into a cough>>.
Chinese: %%<<他发出一声疲惫的轻笑,笑到一半变成咳嗽>>。

English: Oh my, I recognise you now. You're one of the prisoners. Gods, the Inquisitor must be really desperate.
Chinese: 哎呀,我认出你了。你是那些囚犯之一。神啊,审判官是真的走投无路了。

English: You know you're going to die, right? Those bastards wiped out our whole echelon.
Chinese: 你知道你会死的,对吧?那帮混蛋把我们整个梯队都端了。

English: If you insist on this fool's errand, you might find some supplies at my crashed drop pod.##Follow the river upstream and you should find it, by the waterfall.
Chinese: 你若执意要跑这趟傻差事,可以在我坠落的空投舱里找找补给。##沿着河往上游走,在瀑布边你应该能找到。

English: &&You come to me dressed in rags, claiming to work for the Inquisition? Don't make me laugh.
Chinese: &&你衣衫褴褛地跑来,声称自己为宗教裁判所办事?别逗我笑了。

English: Look, just leave me be. I've failed the Inquisition. I'd rather die in peace.
Chinese: 听着,别管我。我辜负了宗教裁判所。我宁愿安安静静地死。

English: Okay, I'll... leave you to it.
Chinese: 好吧,那……不打扰你了。

English: To progress, you must unlock this door. You will need a [[lockpick]] to begin. You should find an ample supply next to me.
Chinese: 要继续前进,你必须打开这扇门。你需要一把[[开锁器]]来起步。我旁边就有充足的供应。

English: When picking a lock, there is always a chance you will fail and the lockpick will break. To pick locks more easily, increase your [[Lockpick Skill]].
Chinese: 撬锁时,总有失败并把开锁器弄断的可能。想更容易地开锁,就提升你的[[开锁技能]]。

English: Mechanical locks are not the only security measure you will come across.##There is an art to disguising secrets through magical means.
Chinese: 机械锁并不是你会遇到的唯一安保手段。##用魔法手段掩盖秘密,也是一门艺术。

English: In this room, the [[candlesticks]] on the wall have been enchanted to seal a secret passageway.##To dispell them, you will need enough [[Lore Skill]].
Chinese: 在这个房间里,墙上的[[烛台]]被施了魔法,封印着一条秘密通道。##要驱散它们,你需要足够的[[博识技能]]。

English: The incantation will also deplete your [[Mana]] slightly.
Chinese: 这个咒文也会略微消耗你的[[法力]]。

English: A single passageway may need several switches, so always be mindful of your surroundings.
Chinese: 一条通道可能需要好几个开关,所以要时刻留意周围环境。

English: Over our pitiful lives, humans accrue beliefs... and delusions. When a person dies, sometimes a glimmer of who they were lingers, for a time.
Chinese: 在我们可怜的一生中,人类积累着信念……和妄想。当一个人死去,有时会有一缕他们生前的微光,短暂地徘徊不去。

English: This ethereal skull is a [[Glimmer of Delusion]].##Collect enough and you will acquire a full [[Delusion]], which allows you to increase a [[Core Attribute]].
Chinese: 这颗虚渺的头骨是一枚[[妄想微光]]。##收集足够多,你就能合成一个完整的[[妄想]],用以提升一项[[核心属性]]。

English: You may also develop Delusions of your own, by completing quests and overcoming challenges.
Chinese: 完成任务、克服挑战,你也可以孕育出自己的妄想。

English: See the [[tower]] up on the cliff? That is where [[Vela Callose]] was last sighted.##Make your way to that tower and confront her. Do not tarry!
Chinese: 看见悬崖上那座[[塔]]了吗?那是[[薇拉·卡洛斯]]最后一次现身的地方。##前往那座塔与她当面对质。切莫拖延!

English: Where are you going, Prisoner XVII? Are you attempting to run from your duty? ##If you ((must)) recuperate, the [[lift]] next to me will take you back to the [[Inquisition camp...]]
Chinese: 你要去哪儿,十七号囚犯?你是想逃避职责吗?##若你((非要))休整,我旁边的[[升降机]]会把你送回[[宗教裁判所营地……]]

English: But Vela is still in the fortress, as we strongly suggest you [[go back inside]] and find a way to reach the [[battlements, up above.]]
Chinese: 但薇拉还在堡垒里,我们强烈建议你[[回到里面]],想办法登上[[上方的城垛]]。

English: In this house you'll find a [[bed]] and a [[Crystal Point]]. You should make use of both.
Chinese: 这座房子里有一张[[床]]和一个[[水晶锚点]].两者你都该好好利用。

English: Resting restores your [[Health]], [[Mana]] and [[Maximum Stamina.]] You may only rest in a bed when it's safe to do so.
Chinese: 休息可恢复你的[[生命]]、[[法力]]和[[最大体力]].只有在安全时才可以在床上休息。

English: Crystal Points restore [[Mana]] and [[save the game]]. They also grant a [[Home Spell]], which will return you to the last used Crystal Point.
Chinese: 水晶锚点可恢复[[法力]]并[[保存游戏]].它们还会赋予你[[归乡法术]],可把你送回最后使用过的水晶锚点。

English: Remember that [[spells]] and [[usable items]] must be equipped before use, just like weapons.
Chinese: 记住,[[法术]]和[[可用物品]]和武器一样,必须先装备才能使用。

English: <<Vela Callose stands with gravitas, her voice piercing the clatter of the ship. You notice blood seeps from her armour; she is wounded, but hides it well.>>
Chinese: <<薇拉·卡洛斯气度沉稳地站着,她的声音穿透飞船的嘈杂。你注意到鲜血正从她的铠甲里渗出;她受了伤,但掩饰得很好。>>

English: Loose the sails! And why is the antigrav engine not running? ## <<Suddenly, you catch her eye.>>
Chinese: 升帆!反重力引擎怎么还没启动?##<<突然,你引起了她的注意。>>

English: What's this, a straggler? The Dark Star company greets you. My apologies, but you have caught us at a rather... inopportune moment.
Chinese: 这是什么,一个掉队的?黑星佣兵团向你问好。抱歉,你来的时机实在……不太凑巧。

English: Vela Callose, I've come to apprehend you in the name of the Inquisition.
Chinese: 薇拉·卡洛斯,我奉宗教裁判所之名,前来缉拿你。

English: <<She throws her head back and laughs.>> ## Oh, that's good. ((You've)) come to apprehend me? You look like you need a meal and a lie down. I don't think you're in a state to apprehend a silkslug.
Chinese: <<她仰头大笑。>>##哦,真有意思。((你))来缉拿我?你看起来需要吃顿饱饭再躺下歇歇。我看你这状态,连只丝蛞蝓都缉拿不了。

English: Those Inquisition dogs really must be desperate, eh? Still, we can't tarry here. Events are in motion that can't be stopped.
Chinese: 宗教裁判所那帮狗腿子真的是走投无路了,嗯?不过,我们不能在此逗留。大势已动,无法阻挡。

English: I've just escaped from an Inquisition prison. Can I join you?
Chinese: 我刚从宗教裁判所的监狱里逃出来。我能加入你们吗?

English: <<She looks you up and down, smirking.>> ## I mean no offence, but the Dark Star company has certain standards. You don't quite fit the bill.
Chinese: <<她上下打量你,露出得意的笑。>>##无意冒犯,但黑星佣兵团是有门槛的。你还不太够格。

English: Prepare yourself, straggler. Great deeds are afoot. Deeds that will bring the Apostatic Union's tyranny to an end... and that will usher in a new age of Heaven.
Chinese: 准备好吧,掉队的。大事将起。这些大事将终结叛教联盟的暴政……并开启天堂的新纪元。

English: And with that, we must take our leave. It's been a pleasure, but I doubt we'll meet again.
Chinese: 说到这儿,我们该告辞了。与你交谈很愉快,但恐怕我们不会再见了。

English: So, Vela escaped, eh? Our drones detected her vessel's departure.
Chinese: 所以,薇拉逃了,嗯?我们的无人机探测到了她飞船的离开。

English: I couldn't apprehend her. I failed.
Chinese: 我没能抓住她。我失败了。

English: Well, you survived, and that's something. From the looks of you, I was sure you'd be butchered almost immediately.
Chinese: 嗯,你活下来了,这就不容易。看你这副模样,我本来确信你转眼就会被宰了。

English: I played your little game. Will you let me free?
Chinese: 我陪你玩了你的小游戏。你会放我自由吗?

English: Oh my, no, not at all. You're still a prisoner, remember?
Chinese: 哎呀,不,完全不是。你还是囚犯,记得吗?

English: And anyway, the deal still stands. Vela's still out there, and with you looking for her, The mission is not a failure. Not ((technically)).
Chinese: 而且无论如何,约定依然有效。薇拉还在外面,只要你在找她,任务就不算失败。严格((意义))上不算。

English: Next, we need to ascertain where Vela may have gone. We have intel on a number of Dark Star mercenaries who flew the roost; we need to pay them a visit.
Chinese: 接下来,我们得查明薇拉可能去了哪里。我们掌握了数名不告而别的黑星佣兵的情报;我们得去拜访他们。

English: I've arranged a meeting with Vela's former [[Quartermaster]], who will meet you in the [[Wobbly Noggin]] pub. Check your [[Quest Log]] for more information.
Chinese: 我已经安排好了与薇拉前[[军需官]]的会面,他将在[[摇晃酒馆]]与你碰头。更多信息请查看你的[[任务日志]]。

English: In the meantime, we can use this God War fortress as a base of operations. Return here if you need to resupply.
Chinese: 与此同时,我们可以把这座神之战堡垒用作行动基地。需要补给就回这里来。

English: I'm giving you an [[Apostatic Union Passport Document]]. It will grant access across a Union gatebridge, like the one to the south.
Chinese: 我发给你一份[[叛教联盟护照文件]].它可以让你通过联盟的关卡桥,比如南边那座。

English: So, what are you waiting for? Get going!
Chinese: 那么,你还等什么?出发吧!

English: Greetin's. The bridge is closed, unless you're the bearer of a genuine Apostatic Union passport. So if you've not got one... get lost.
Chinese: 你好啊。桥关着,除非你持有货真价实的叛教联盟护照。所以你要是没带……滚一边去。

English: I've got a passport right here.
Chinese: 我这就带着护照。

English: Hmm.. seal looks good. I'm not seein' any signs of magical forgery. Yup, looks like you can pass.
Chinese: 嗯……封印看起来没问题。没看出魔法伪造的痕迹。行,你可以过了。

English: Looks like you 'aint got squat. Go on, get outta here.
Chinese: 看来你什么都没带。走吧,滚出去。

English: Where can I get a passport?
Chinese: 我在哪里能弄到护照?

English: Mostly they're granted by higher-ups in the Union. Inquisitors an' councillors and the like. But I heard there's a shop in Hallow town that sells 'em... for a hefty price.
Chinese: 大多由联盟的高层签发。审判官、议员之流。不过听说哈洛镇有家店卖这个……价格不菲。

English: Remember that passports are single use. One passport grants you lifetime travel over one bridge - but no others.
Chinese: 记住,护照是一次性的。一本护照让你终身通行一座桥——其他桥不行。

English: I'll be going, then.
Chinese: 那我走了。

English: <<He rifles through some paperwork.>> ## Yup, looks like you're on the list. Go on, get going.
Chinese: <<他翻检了一下文件。>>##嗯,看来你在名单上。走吧,上路吧。

English: Greetin's. This 'ere bridge leads to the Kingdom of the Endless. Nasty place full of shuffling corpses, it is.
Chinese: 你好啊。这座桥通往无尽者之国。鬼地方,全是拖着脚走的行尸。

English: The bridge is closed, unless you're the bearer of a genuine Apostatic Union passport. So if you've not got one... get lost.
Chinese: 桥关着,除非你持有货真价实的叛教联盟护照。所以你要是没带……滚一边去。

English: The Union isn't issuing new passports to Pwyll at the moment... some kind of precaution.##They're hard to come by, but someone around [[town]] might be able to help you... Have you met the [[Weightmaster]]?
Chinese: 联盟目前不给普威尔签发新护照……某种预防措施。##护照很难弄到,但[[镇]]上可能有人能帮你……你见过[[秤量官]]了吗?

English: What are you doing? No offense, but you'd better leave this to the professionals.
Chinese: 你在干什么?无意冒犯,但你最好把这交给专业人士。

English: You look like you've just crawled out of a bush. What are you, some sort of escaped convict?
Chinese: 你这副样子像刚从灌木丛里爬出来的。你是什么人,逃犯吗?

English: You don't look so good, Confessor. Let's make this quick.
Chinese: 你脸色不太好,忏悔者。我们速战速决吧。

English: <<You wake with a pounding head. You gasp for breath; your lungs fill with acrid air. Everything hurts.>>
Chinese: <<你在头痛欲裂中醒来。你大口喘息;肺部灌满刺鼻的空气。浑身都疼。>>

English: <<Basalt eyes you without sympathy.>> ##You look like squidshit, Confessor.
Chinese: <<巴索特毫无同情地看着你。>>##你看起来像一坨乌贼屎,忏悔者。

English: You must feel like you've been chewed up by a typhos. Let me fill you in. ##<<He gestures around you.>> The cutter crashed.
Chinese: 你现在的感觉一定像被提福斯蛇嚼过一遍。让我给你补补课。##<<他指了指你周围。>>快艇坠毁了。

English: Well, thought I'd spell it out for you. The curse rots one's ((mind)), after all.
Chinese: 嗯,我想还是给你说明白的好。毕竟那诅咒会腐蚀人的((心智))。

English: Well... not ((just)) that.
Chinese: 嗯……不光是((那))个。

English: Y'see, we'd stashed a bunch of protective suits in the cutter. Thick leather garments sealed with stitches and cipher, to ward off the miasma that clings to the air down here.
Chinese: 你瞧,我们在快艇里存了一批防护服。用针脚和密文封死的厚皮衣,用来抵御弥漫在这地下空气里的毒瘴。

English: But... they all got burned up in the crash. The only thing we could save... <<He taps his mask.>> ...was ((this)) one.
Chinese: 但是……它们全在坠机时烧光了。我们唯一抢救下来的……<<他敲了敲自己的面罩。>>……就是((这))一副。

English: So that dizziness? The head pain? The stinging in your lungs? I'm afraid that's the miasma. The [[curse]]. I'm... sorry.
Chinese: 所以那阵晕眩?头痛?肺里的刺痛?恐怕那就是毒瘴。[[诅咒]].我很……抱歉。

English: <<He shrugs.>> Depends on the exposure time. If we get this done quick, you might have a chance.
Chinese: <<他耸肩。>>取决于暴露时长。若我们速战速决,你或许还有机会。

English: <<A muffled chuckle.>> Finders keepers, ((Confessor)). I ain't throwing my life away for yours.
Chinese: <<一声闷笑。>>先到先得,((忏悔者)).我可不会拿我的命换你的。

English: <<He slaps you on the shoulder.>> That's the spirit, eh? You'd 'ave made a fine Dark Star, back in the day.
Chinese: <<他拍了拍你的肩膀。>>这就对了,嗯?放到从前,你本可以成为一名出色的黑星。

English: <<He looks around.>> Anyway, you might be able to salvage some sorta [[protection]] down here, if you're lucky. There's been plenty of foolhardy expeditions to the Underlands, and the archaeologists - well, let's just say they don't often come ((back)).
Chinese: <<他环顾四周。>>总之,你要是走运,或许能在这下面捡到某种[[防护]].来地下之地的莽夫远征队多得是,至于那些考古学家——这么说吧,他们可不常((回来))。

English: The others will be fine. Frost and the Emberian have respirators built into their suits, and the Duchess... well, she's not been breathing for centuries, anyway.
Chinese: 其他人不会有事。弗罗斯特和余烬人的铠甲里都内置了呼吸器,女公爵嘛……反正她已经几百年没呼吸过了。

English: The understorms were brutal. When you're inside the clouds you can't see shit; there's just flashes of light and deafening thunder. I tried to steer her the best I could, but... it was always gonna be a gamble.
Chinese: 地底风暴太凶了。在云里你什么都看不见;只有闪光和震耳欲聋的雷声。我拼尽全力稳住船,但……这本来就是一场赌博。

English: Truth be told, we're only here because of the Duchess. Without her cipher wards I doubt we'd still be in one piece.
Chinese: 说实话,我们能到这儿全靠女公爵。没有她的密文护符,我怀疑我们早就散架了。

English: We're a bit far from the mark. Orlaith - ((the Emberian)), I mean - thinks she can see the [[Cradle]] through the miasma, but it's a ways away. We'll need to cross that wasteland of rusted steel. A tall order.
Chinese: 我们离目标还有点远。奥莱丝——我是说((余烬人))——觉得她能透过毒瘴看见[[摇篮]],但还有一段路。我们得穿过那片锈铁荒原。这可是件苦差。

English: Frost thinks our best bet is to try reaching this [[coach house]] down the road. If we're lucky, we could salvage an Emberian [[autocoach]]. I've no idea what that is, but Frost thinks it can get us through the wasteland unscathed.
Chinese: 弗罗斯特觉得最好的办法是沿路去那座[[车厢库]].走运的话,我们能捡到一辆余烬[[自动车厢]].我都不知道那是什么玩意,但弗罗斯特觉得它能带我们毫发无损地穿过荒原。

English: It's a long shot, but, well - none of us have any better ideas.
Chinese: 希望渺茫,但,嗯——我们谁也没有更好的主意。

English: So, as the ((leader)) of this little jaunt, we figure you'll be wanting to scout ahead, eh Confessor? ##Don't worry - we'll be right behind you. <<He winks.>>
Chinese: 所以,作为这趟小小远足的((领队)),我们想你肯定乐意去前面探路,对吧,忏悔者?##别担心——我们就在你身后。<<他眨眨眼。>>

English: Good stuff. With that attitude, we'll be back by supper.
Chinese: 好样的。就这股劲头,晚饭前我们就能回去了。

English: Remember: just scout a route past the machines down there, and we'll all meet up in that [[small canyon]] ahead.
Chinese: 记住:只需探明一条绕过下面那些机器的路线,我们就在前方那道[[小峡谷]]会合。

English: Well, maybe you'll fit right in with all the nasties down here, eh? You can just... <<He makes a weaving motion with his hand.>> ...slip right by, right?
Chinese: 嗯,说不定你跟这底下的那些脏东西正好合拍,嗯?你就可以……<<他用手比了个穿行的动作。>>……直接溜过去,对吧?

English: <<He frowns.>> Look, ((Confessor)). I'm tryna be polite, and show you some respect. But let's get one thing straight.
Chinese: <<他皱眉。>>听着,((忏悔者)).我是想客客气气,给你几分尊重。但有一件事得说清楚。

English: Your fancy ((High Confessor)) ain't here to prop you up. There's no Inquisition agents. No Union guards. It's just you and a bunch of ((former)) Dark Stars.
Chinese: 你那位了不起的((至高忏悔者))可不在这儿给你撑腰。没有宗教裁判所特工。没有联盟卫兵。只有你,和一群((前))黑星。

English: So if you start tryin' ta pull rank, and order us around - how do you think that's gonna ((go)), eh?
Chinese: 所以你要是开始摆架子,对我们呼来喝去——你觉得那会((怎么样)),嗯?

English: No shit.
Chinese: 可不是嘛。

English: So that's why I feel awful.
Chinese: 所以我才感觉这么糟。

English: So, am I going to die?
Chinese: 所以,我会死吗?

English: Give me ((your)) mask. ((Now)).
Chinese: 把((你))的面罩给我。((现在))。

English: I'll be fine.
Chinese: 我没事的。

English: How did we crash?
Chinese: 我们怎么坠机的?

English: How did you say we crashed?
Chinese: 你刚说我们是怎么坠机的?

English: So, what's the plan?
Chinese: 那么,计划是什么?

English: Remind me what our plan is now?
Chinese: 提醒我一下现在的计划?

English: Alright. I'll get going.
Chinese: 好。我这就出发。

English: I suppose I'll get going.
Chinese: 我想我该出发了。

English: But ((I'm)) the one who's cursed.
Chinese: 但被诅咒的是((我))。

English: I order ((you)) to go, instead.
Chinese: 我命令((你))去。

English: So, we're actually here. The ominous Underlands, below the clouds.
Chinese: 所以,我们真的到了。云层之下,不祥的地下之地。

English: Even four centuries ago, back when I could breathe fresh air, this place had a mystical quality. From Verdant we could see the twinkling lights of Emberian cities, distant and beautiful, far below us.
Chinese: 即便是四个世纪前,在我还能呼吸新鲜空气的时候,这地方就有一种神秘的气质。从翠绿之地,我们能看见余烬城市的闪烁灯火,遥远而美丽,在我们的下方深处。

English: Once I even met one. An Emberian delegate was sent to meet with my father. They arrived in a craft of pure metal; I had never seen anything like it...
Chinese: 我甚至见过一次余烬人。一位余烬使者被派来与我的父亲会面。他们乘坐着一艘纯金属的飞行器而来;我从未见过那样的东西……

English: But I must admit, to be here after all these years feels... underwhelming. I had thought that even in death their cities would hold a certain majesty, just as my own home still does. But this is a dreary, ugly place, strewn with rust and bone.
Chinese: 但我必须承认,这么多年后身处此地,感觉……令人失望。我原以为即使死去,他们的城市也会保有一份庄严,就像我的故乡至今仍有的那样。但这里只是一片阴郁丑陋之地,遍布锈铁与骸骨。

English: Let us not linger more than we need to.
Chinese: 我们还是别作多余的逗留。

English: <<She waves a hand dismissively.>> Oh, I've already done all I can. ##While you were unconscious, I sealed your organs with cipher. That should buy you some time.
Chinese: <<她不以为意地挥了挥手。>>哦,我已经尽力了。##你昏迷的时候,我用密文封住了你的器官。这应该能为你争取些时间。

English: <<After a moment of silence, she sighs.>> Look, Confessor. I apologise if I seem flippant. It's just... to us Endless, the plight of mortals can seem ((quaint)).
Chinese: <<沉默片刻后,她叹息。>>听着,忏悔者。若我显得轻慢,我道歉。只是……对我们无尽者来说,凡人的困境有时显得颇为((别致))。

English: Sure enough, you will experience ((agonising)) pain as the miasma takes hold. Your body will atrophy as it is consumed by fungi, gradually stiffening until you are rooted in place. There you will stay, for centuries or more, dimly conscious of your torment.
Chinese: 果不其然,当毒瘴发作时,你将经历((撕心裂肺))的剧痛。你的身体会被真菌吞噬而萎缩,逐渐僵硬,直到你扎根原地。你将在那里待上数百年甚至更久,隐隐意识到自己的苦楚。

English: I know to ((you)) it probably seems like a tiresome ordeal. But to someone like myself, who has already experienced a half-millennia of anguish...
Chinese: 我知道对((你))而言,这或许像是一场烦人的磨难。但对像我这样已经历了五百年痛苦的人来说……

English: Well, it actually sounds rather interesting. Variety is the spice of unlife, no?
Chinese: 嗯,这听起来其实相当有趣。变化乃不死生活的调味料,不是吗?

English: Nonetheless, I do not wish this fate upon you. We should make haste.
Chinese: 尽管如此,我并不希望你遭此命运。我们得抓紧了。

English: The Emberians were masters of fusing the ethereal with the physical; cipher with machine. Forget what petty trinkets you may have witnessed in the Clockwork Kingdom - they are mere imitations of what the Emberians could create at their peak.
Chinese: 余烬人曾是融合虚渺与实体的大师;密文与机械的大师。忘掉你在发条王国见过的那些小玩意吧——那不过是余烬人鼎盛时期造物的拙劣模仿。

English: It is said they even made machines that could walk and talk, with functioning minds of pure cipher logic. ##As someone who has studied the art of cipher for longer than any mortal, I can tell you plain: this is no simple feat.
Chinese: 据说他们甚至造出了能行走、能说话的机器,拥有纯粹密文逻辑运转的心智。##以一个研习密文之术比任何凡人都久的人的身份,我可以坦白告诉你:这绝非易事。

English: It has been said their creations have outlived the Emberians themselves, and still linger down here. If this was the ((only)) danger we faced, I would be rightly concerned; but it is not all.
Chinese: 据说他们的造物比余烬人本身活得还久,至今仍在下面游荡。若这是我们要面对的((唯一))危险,我自然会忧心;但事情不止于此。

English: The World Rend was a syntax cascade that unravelled the very essence of everything it touched. Many people were killed, but some bore a worse fate; twisted into wraiths of malign intent.
Chinese: 世界撕裂是一场句法级联,把它触及的万物的本源都拆解了。许多人死去,但一些人遭遇了更悲惨的命运;被扭曲成心怀恶意的怨灵。

English: Whatever we need to do down here, we should do it ((quickly)).
Chinese: 无论我们在这下面要做什么,都应该((尽快))。

English: Ah, that's my [[transpositional supply tent]]. It's woven with an intricate cipher spell that distorts time and space, so it's far bigger on the inside than it appears.
Chinese: 啊,那是我的[[置换补给帐篷]]。它织入了精巧的密文咒语,能扭曲时空,所以内部远比外表看起来大得多。

English: Feel free to use it to [[craft]] or stock up on [[supplies]]. There's also a portal that leads back to my dwelling in the Endless Realm, though at this stage I think it would be unwise to retreat; we should press on.
Chinese: 请随意用它来[[锻造]]或补给[[物资]]。里面还有一道传送门,通向我在无尽领域的居所,不过到了这一步,我认为撤退是不智的;我们应当继续前进。

English: Agreed. I'll get moving.
Chinese: 同意。我这就动身。

English: I'm cursed. Can you help?
Chinese: 我被诅咒了。你能帮忙吗?

English: Do you know what dangers we face?
Chinese: 你知道我们会遇到什么危险吗?

English: What's with the tent?
Chinese: 那顶帐篷是怎么回事?

English: You know, all my life I've had these... recurring dreams.
Chinese: 你知道吗,我这辈子一直做这些……反复出现的梦。

English: All my life I've dreamed of the Emberians' shimmering towers. And what have they left us? Nothing but fabric draped over a weak scaffold.
Chinese: 我这辈子都梦见余烬人熠熠生辉的高塔。而他们给我们留下了什么?不过是搭在脆弱骨架上的一层布料。

English: A metropolis of light. Towers of shimmering steel and cipher. Vast ships sliding through the air like they weigh nothing at all.
Chinese: 一座光之都会。闪烁着钢铁与密文的高塔。巨大的飞船划过天空,仿佛毫无重量。

English: <<She sighs.>> I think part of me... has always been searching for this place. Just to ((see)) it with my own eyes. ##And now I'm finally ((here)) - is this wasteland really all that's left?
Chinese: <<她叹气。>>我觉得我身体里的某一部分……一直在寻找这个地方。只为亲眼((看看))它。##如今我终于((到了))——这片荒原就是剩下的一切吗?

English: I thought the Emberians, for all their hubris and arrogance, had built something that would ((endure)). But maybe their achievement was just a ((dream)) after all. Nothing but fabric draped over a weak scaffold.
Chinese: 我以为余烬人纵有万般狂妄与傲慢,也建成了能((长存))的东西。但也许他们的成就终究只是一场((梦))。不过是搭在脆弱骨架上的一层布料。

English: Far in the distance, past the fog and lightning, there's a giant metal orb. ((That's)) the [[Cradle]], the most advanced piece of tech, or magic, or ((both)), to have existed.
Chinese: 在遥远的远方,越过迷雾与闪电,有一个巨大的金属球。((那))就是[[摇篮]],有史以来最先进的造物,无论科技、魔法,还是((两者兼有))。

English: ((That's)) where Vela is; no doubt about it. She's been planning this for ((years)). And if we're going to stop her from activating it, we'd better move fast - Vela is well ahead of us already.
Chinese: 薇拉就((在))那里;毫无疑问。她为这件事谋划了((多年)).若要阻止她启动它,我们最好加快脚步——薇拉已经远远走在前头了。

English: <<She nods.>> I'm sorry about that, Confessor. I've seen people come back from expeditions - even just from low-lying islands - afflicted with the curse.
Chinese: <<她点头。>>我很遗憾,忏悔者。我见过远征归来的人——哪怕只是去过地势较低的岛屿——染上那诅咒。

English: I'm sure you don't need me to tell you how bad it can be. But the Duchess has already worked her magic on you, and if we get this over with quickly, you should recover.
Chinese: 不用我说你也知道那有多糟。不过女公爵已经对你施过法了,只要我们快点把这事办完,你应该能恢复。

English: <<She shifts her sword.>> Alright, lead the way.
Chinese: <<她挪了挪剑。>>好,带路吧。

English: If you say so. I'll wait here.
Chinese: 你说了算。我在这里等。

English: <<She nods.>>
Something on your mind?
Chinese: 有心事?

English: You go on ahead, Confessor. I'll make sure the others can get through safe.
Chinese: 你先走,忏悔者。我确保其他人安全通过。

English: <<She winces.>> Taken one blow too many, Confessor. You go on ahead while I catch my breath.
Chinese: <<她龇牙咧嘴。>>挨了太多下,忏悔者。你先走,我喘口气。

English: Do you know where Vela is?
Chinese: 你知道薇拉在哪吗?

English: I've been cursed by the miasma.
Chinese: 我被毒瘴诅咒了。

English: Let's join arms and fight together.
Chinese: 我们并肩作战吧。

English: Let's split up.
Chinese: 我们分头行动吧。

English: Let's get going.
Chinese: 我们走吧。

English: <<Frost is peering through a spyglass at the edifice of metal and shattered glass upon the nearby clifftop.>> ##Magnificent. The structure is very nearly intact. Imagine what it was like in its prime!
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特正透过单筒望远镜,凝视着附近崖顶上那座金属与碎玻璃的巨构。>>##壮丽。这建筑几乎完好无损。想想它鼎盛时期的样子!

English: <<Frost lowers his spyglass to regard you coolly.>> ##Still dallying, darling? Remember, every minute you spend down here without a mask will bring you closer to death...
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特放下望远镜,冷冷地打量你。>>##还在磨蹭,亲爱的?记住,你在这下面每多待一分钟不戴面罩,就离死亡更近一步……

English: <<He lowers the spyglass and examines you, looking remarkably unruffled by the crash.>> ##You've survived, then? Well done. Knew you had it in you.
Chinese: <<他放下望远镜打量你,神情出奇地不为坠机所动。>>##那么,你活下来了?干得好。我就知道你有这本事。

English: By all objective yardsticks, our situation is dire... and yet I can't help but feel a sense of anticipation. Uncovering the secrets of this place has been my life's work, and now we are pursuing the greatest secret of all.
Chinese: 按一切客观标准衡量,我们的处境岌岌可危……但我却忍不住心生期待。揭开此地的秘密是我毕生的事业,而如今我们正追寻着所有秘密中最伟大的那个。

English: How ironic that it should be due to my own mistakes, rather than those of some comfortably long-dead civilisation... ##<<He mutters to himself.>> Keep your head in the game, Horace. Or Caxton? Whatever.
Chinese: 讽刺的是,造成这一切的竟是我自己的过失,而非某个早已安逸作古的文明……##<<他喃喃自语。>>专心点,霍勒斯。还是卡克斯顿?随便吧。

English: Alas, our bumpy landing has left me without the requisite material to improvise a new [[filtration mask]]. But we're not far from where the Munro Expedition went down back in '35. ((Some)) of their equipment ((might)) still be intact.
Chinese: 唉,我们那趟颠簸的着陆,让我没了 improvising 一副新[[过滤面罩]]所需的材料。不过我们离'35 年门罗探险队坠毁的地方不远。他们的装备((有些))((可能))还完好。

English: Your sole chance of survival is to [[limit your exposure]]. Every minute, every ((heartbeat)) that you spend here without a mask will bring you closer to a fate worse than death.
Chinese: 你唯一的生路是[[减少暴露时间]]。你在这里不戴面罩的每一分钟、每一次((心跳)),都会让你离一个比死更糟的下场更近。

English: Should you fail, I can at least offer you the same remedy I gave my old colleague Magda. ##<<He digs in a pocket and opens his palm to reveal a little ball of some waxy substance.>>
Chinese: 倘若你撑不住,我至少能给你我当年给我老同事玛格达的同一剂药。##<<他在口袋里摸索,摊开手掌,露出一小团蜡状物。>>

English: Venom of the purple-spotted typhos. Extremely deadly, and quite painless. ##She made me promise, you see.
Chinese: 紫斑提福斯蛇的毒液。剧毒,而且毫无痛苦。##你瞧,她要过我承诺。

English: Then you'd better hurry. Tick-tock, my dear, tick-tock...
Chinese: 那你最好抓紧。滴答,亲爱的,滴答……

English: As Willem the Slug((lover)) said to the young maid, it was only the once. Back in '33, I was chosen to lead the Clockwork Kingdom's first and only surface expedition. At the time, I considered this a high honour.
Chinese: 正如蛞蝓((爱好者))威廉对少女说的:仅此一次。回到'33 年,我被选中率领发条王国第一次、也是唯一一次地表远征。当时,我把这视为极高的荣誉。

English: Only by a miracle of impromptu engineering did we fare any better than old Stultus in '26. A mere half of us died, instead of all.
Chinese: 多亏了临场工程的奇迹,我们才比'26 年的老斯图尔图斯那队强了一点。只死了一半人,而不是全灭。

English: Still, chin up, eh? Back then we didn't have the [[Duchess]] with us.
Chinese: 不过,打起精神,对吧?那时我们可没有[[女公爵]]同行。

English: Correct. In ancient days this entire continent was criss-crossed by an advanced transportation network, allowing the Emberians to travel hundreds of leagues per day in perfect comfort.
Chinese: 没错。远古时代,这片大陆被一张先进的交通网络纵横贯穿,让余烬人每天能舒舒服服地出行数百里格。

English: These '[[autocoaches]]', as contemporary scholars have dubbed them, were propelled at high velocity along special courses by some unknown means. If you've ever been inside a modern-day [[mining operation]], you may have seen wagon tracks inspired by their example.
Chinese: 这些"[[自动车厢]]"——当代学者如此命名——以某种未知的方式,沿着特殊轨道高速行驶。若你进过现代的[[矿区]],或许见过受它们启发而铺设的矿车轨道。

English: Hence, our first priority must be to get... <<He points up at the clifftop.>> ##((There)). If any such conveyance remains operable, I believe I can commandeer it.
Chinese: 因此,我们的头等大事是抵达……<<他指向崖顶。>>##((那里)).若还有任何一辆这样的车厢能开动,我相信我能征用它。

English: I'm cursed. Can you rig up some kind of protective device?
Chinese: 我被诅咒了。你能弄个什么防护装置出来吗?

English: Are you sure you can't do anything about my curse?
Chinese: 你确定对我的诅咒毫无办法?

English: ...I'll pass for now, thanks.
Chinese: ……这次先算了,谢谢。

English: I might just take you up on that, if it comes to it.
Chinese: 真到那一步,我可能会考虑你的提议。

English: So you've been to the Underlands before?
Chinese: 所以你以前来过地下之地?

English: Basalt said you had some plan to get out of here.
Chinese: 巴索特说你有离开这里的办法。

English: I suppose I'll get going.
Chinese: 我想我该走了。

English: <<Frost is fiddling with a hand-held device that resembles the offspring of a dulcimer and a carriage clock.>> ##Silence, if you please. This procedure requires concentration...
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特正在摆弄一台手持装置,样子像洋琴和马车钟的私生子。>>##请安静。这道工序需要专心……

English: <<A deep mechanical boom sounds from within the wall as the door begin to grind open.>> ##Ah-((ha)).
Chinese: <<随着门开始磨擦着打开,墙内响起深沉的机械轰鸣。>>##啊-((哈))。

English: Evidently the Emberians haven't revised their sealing spells since my last visit. Rather careless of them, hm?
Chinese: 显然自我上次造访以来,余烬人就没修订过他们的封印咒语。可真够粗心的,嗯?

English: Incidentally, I believe we are close to that [[crash site]] I mentioned. If you wish to survive this little jaunt, I suggest you search the area for a [[filtration mask]].
Chinese: 顺便说一句,我想我们离我提到的那处[[坠机点]]不远了。若你想活着走完这趟小游,我建议你在这一带找找[[过滤面罩]]。

English: Incidentally, I believe we are close to where the Munro Expedition crashed back in '35. If you wish to survive this little jaunt, I suggest you [[search the wreckage]] for a working [[filtration mask]].
Chinese: 顺便说一句,我想我们离'35 年门罗探险队坠毁的地方不远了。若你想活着走完这趟小游,我建议你[[搜索残骸]],找一副还能用的[[过滤面罩]]。

English: I do believe we are close to that [[crash site]] I mentioned. If you wish to survive this little jaunt, I suggest you search the area for a [[filtration mask]].
Chinese: 我确实认为,我们离我提到的那处[[坠机点]]不远了。若你想活着走完这趟小游,我建议你在这一带找找[[过滤面罩]]。

English: You've found a [[filtration mask]]? Very good. I daresay Captain Munro and his crew no longer have any use for it, stars rest their souls.
Chinese: 你找到[[过滤面罩]]了?很好。我敢说门罗船长和他的船员已经用不上它了,愿星灵安息他们的灵魂。

English: First, our vessel's buoyancy engine broke down upon arrival. Then our signal flares proved to be duds, so we missed our rescue rendezvous.
Chinese: 首先,我们飞船的浮力引擎一到就坏了。接着信号弹被证明是哑弹,于是我们错过了救援会合。

English: Our thaumometer fritzed out at anything above 7.3 millihex. And our faulty breathing casks became over-pressurised, causing us to hallucinate.
Chinese: 我们的奇术测量仪一超过7.3毫赫克斯就失灵。我们的呼吸桶又因故障过度加压,害我们产生幻觉。

English: It was my first inkling that the Clockwork Kingdom's vaunted manufacturing prowess might be in decline. ##Frankly, without my late colleague Magda, I wouldn't be standing here today.
Chinese: 那是我头一次隐约觉得,发条王国引以为傲的制造实力或许正在衰落。##坦白说,没有我已故的同事玛格达,我今天就不会站在这里。

English: In the end everyone got medals, living and dead, and the King no doubt thought our discoveries many times more valuable than what we had paid for them.
Chinese: 最后人人都有勋章,活人死人都有,而国王无疑认为我们的发现比我们付出的代价值钱许多倍。

English: By all means. I will remain here for a few ticks, to ensure no one is left behind.
Chinese: 请便。我会在这里留几个滴答,确保没人掉队。

English: What happened on your last expedition, anyway?
Chinese: 你上次远征到底发生了什么?

English: Let's keep moving.
Chinese: 我们继续前进吧。

English: See that [[coach house]] up above? You know, that thing that looks like ((no couch house you've ever seen))?
Chinese: 看见上面那座[[车厢库]]了吗?就是那玩意,((不像你见过的任何车厢库))的那种?

English: Well, that's where we're trying to get to. Frost reckons if there's an Emberian [[autocoach]] left intact he might be able to fix it up.
Chinese: 嗯,那就是我们要去的地方。弗罗斯特估计,要是还有一辆完好的余烬[[自动车厢]],他没准能修好它。

English: <<She breathes heavily; the stench of machine grease is in the air.>> ##These things... really know how to fight.
Chinese: <<她沉重地喘息;空气里弥漫着机油味。>>##这些东西……真懂得怎么打架。

English: They ain't like the smaller ones I've seen in the Skyrealms. These ones parry and riposte my blows - they learn my moves and react accordingly. It's like they're really ((thinking)).
Chinese: 它们跟我在天空领域见过的小个子不一样。这些会格挡、会还击我的攻击——它们学我的招式,随机应变。就像它们真的在((思考))。

English: If the Emberians built these things with just metal and magic, what ((else)) could they... create?
Chinese: 如果余烬人只用金属和魔法就造出了这些东西,那他们还能……((造出))什么?

English: <<She shifts, suddenly uneasy in her armour, and says no more.>>
Chinese: <<她挪了挪身子,忽然在铠甲中显得局促不安,不再多言。>>

English: <<The Duchess is clutching her head.>> ##Ah... Confessor. I didn't... sense your presence, amongst all this ((noise)).
Chinese: <<女公爵抱着头。>>##啊……忏悔者。在这一切((噪音))之中,我没……察觉到你的到来。

English: I'm not in ((pain)). I'm just... overwhelmed with psychic information.
Chinese: 我不是在((痛))。只是……心灵信息太多了。

English: I meant... ((psychic)) noise. There's so ((much)) it's hard to... shut it out.
Chinese: 我是说……((心灵))噪音。((多))得难以……把它隔绝在外。

English: <<She gestures ahead.>> You see all this fungi? They are not like the growths we get... in the Skyrealms. They are the ((cursed)) bodies of those... <<She winces.>> ...((pitiful)) souls who survived the World Rend.
Chinese: <<她指向前方。>>你看见这些真菌了吗?它们不像我们在……天空领域见到的那些。它们是那些在世界撕裂中幸存的……<<她龇牙咧嘴。>>……((可怜))灵魂的((被诅咒))躯体。

English: Their fungal forms have coalesced... into a superorganism. Their minds are as one, united in anguish and misery. I can hear their silent screams, their fractured memories.
Chinese: 它们的真菌形态已经聚合……成一个超个体。它们的心智融为一体,在苦楚与悲惨中联结。我能听见它们无声的尖叫、破碎的记忆。

English: But one voice stands out from the cacophony. A workman with a [[special key]]. I see it sliding... into an [[autocoach]] lock.
Chinese: 但有一个声音从这片嘈杂中脱颖而出。一个拿着[[特殊钥匙]]的工人。我看见它滑进……一把[[自动车厢]]的锁。

English: He lived... in [[that house]] over yonder. I think you'd do well to pay it a visit.
Chinese: 他住在……那边那座[[房子]]里。我想你去拜访一下为好。

English: Uh, are you all right?
Chinese: 呃,你还好吗?

English: I thought the Endless were used to pain.
Chinese: 我以为无尽者早已习惯痛苦。

English: I don't hear anything.
Chinese: 我什么也没听见。

English: One heck of a view from up 'ere, eh Confessor? Like one of those fancy Byonnian landscape painters slurped some ((bad)) mushroom stew an' painted their fever dream. <<He chuckles.>>
Chinese: 这上面的景色真叫绝,是吧,忏悔者?就像哪个拜昂派山水画家灌了一肚子((变质))蘑菇汤,画出自己的高烧噩梦。<<他轻笑。>>

English: We're in luck. D'ya see that [[city]] in the distance? That's where these [[autocoaches]] should take us. From there, it should be a leisurely stroll to the Cradle.
Chinese: 咱们运气不错。看见远处那座[[城]]了吗?这些[[自动车厢]]应该会把我们送到那儿。从那里到摇篮,应该就是悠哉漫步的距离了。

English: Frost is workin' his magic, but looks like we'll still need a [[key]] to get one of the coaches goin'. ##So, you'd best get looking for one.
Chinese: 弗罗斯特正施着他的魔法,但看来我们还是得弄到一把[[钥匙]]才能让其中一节车厢跑起来。##所以,你最好去找一把。

English: Course, it will be like looking for a needle in a heap o' shit. So, mayhaps the Duchess can help you scry one? ##Last I saw her, she was headed for the [[mushroom forest]] down there.
Chinese: 当然,这就像在一堆粪里找针。所以,说不定女公爵能帮你窥探出一把?##我上次见到她时,她正往下面的[[蘑菇森林]]去。

English: <<Frost emits a torrent of bizarre epithets as he wrestles with the mechanism.>> ##Ten thousand... ((toffee))-chewing... blistering... ((confounded))... ##((FIDDLESTICKS!))
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特在与机械搏斗时,喷出一连串古怪的咒骂。>>##一万句……嚼((太妃糖))的……该死的……((混账))……##((见他的大鬼!))

English: <<He kicks the tram with one steel-capped boot. It rings like a gong.>> ##((Frog)) me backwards with a ((blinking)) battleaxe!
Chinese: <<他一只包钢头的靴子踹向车厢。车厢响得像铜锣。>>##((呱))了我个倒栽葱,拿把((叮当))战斧!

English: <<Frost looks uncharacteristically embarrassed.>> ##Please accept my profound apologies for the delay. This is quite the most advanced machine I've ever encountered, and I'm not accustomed to this degree of... ((obstinacy)).
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特显得出奇地窘迫。>>##请接受我对延误的深深歉意。这是我有生以来遇见过最先进的机器,而我不习惯这种程度的……((倔强))。

English: I've managed to restore motive power, but these [[security measures]] are startling in their elegance. I can only guess that the Emberians considered the autocoach network to be of great strategic value.
Chinese: 我成功恢复了动力,但这些[[安保措施]]的精妙令人咋舌。我只能猜测,余烬人认为自动车厢网络具有重要的战略价值。

English: It all seems to revolve around some sort of [[key]]. Never fear; I'm confident I can bypass it.
Chinese: 一切似乎都围绕某种[[钥匙]]运转。别怕;我有信心绕过它。

English: What? Absolutely not. That would be ((cheating)).
Chinese: 什么?绝对不行。那是((作弊))。

English: Having trouble?
Chinese: 遇到麻烦了?

English: You look like you could do with some help.
Chinese: 你看起来需要帮点忙。

English: I'll just leave you alone.
Chinese: 那我就不打扰你了。

English: Let me see if I can track down this key for you.
Chinese: 让我看看能不能帮你找到这把钥匙。

English: When I was wandering the forest below, I could sense the memories of a thousand Emberians. I saw this place as a sprawling cityscape, with towers and palaces beyond the mastery of any Endless mason.
Chinese: 当我在下面的森林中游荡时,我能感受到千百个余烬人的记忆。我看见这里曾是一片延绵的城市景观,高塔与宫殿之精妙,远非任何无尽石匠所能企及。

English: But to see the same city stretching before me, so ((totally)) destroyed? It's enough to make even I - who has lived many mortal lifespans - ponder the fleetingness of our feeble human exploits.
Chinese: 但亲眼看着同一座城在我面前铺开,却((彻底))成了废墟?这足以让我这个活过许多个凡人寿数的人,也不禁思索起我们人类渺小功业的转瞬即逝。

English: I can see it, lingering on the horizon - the [[Cradle]]. She's so ((close)).
Chinese: 我能看见它,悬在地平线上——[[摇篮]]。她离得那么((近))。

English: There's no time to tarry, Confessor. Let's hurry and get on that [[autocoach]].
Chinese: 没时间磨蹭了,忏悔者。快,我们上那辆[[自动车厢]]。

English: Well, what are you waitin' for? Put that [[key]] into the control panel an' let's get her going.
Chinese: 好了,还等什么?把[[钥匙]]插进控制台,咱们让它跑起来。

English: Well I'll be damned; I've never seen an airship move with such grace. Despite the storms she glides like a cutter on the clearest o' days, an' faster than anything.
Chinese: 我真见了鬼了;我从没见过飞艇开得这么优雅。顶着风暴,她滑行得像最晴朗天气里的小艇,还比什么都快。

English: Well, go ahead and [[use the key]], Confessor. The anticipation is killing me.
Chinese: 好了,去[[用钥匙]]吧,忏悔者。这份期待快把我折磨死了。

English: It's one thing to see it from afar, but moving through these ruins feels downright macabre. I thought Verdant was fordone, but this is so much worse.
Chinese: 远远看着是一回事,穿行在这些废墟之中却是另一回事,阴森得吓人。我以为翠绿之地已经够惨了,但这里还要糟得多。

English: Go ahead and get this thing moving.
Chinese: 去吧,让这家伙动起来。

English: It's the strangest thing. I've never in my life seen a device like this, but riding upon it feels... oddly familiar.
Chinese: 真是怪事。我这辈子从没见过这样的装置,但坐在上面却感觉……说不出的熟悉。

English: You are a spoilsport, do you know that? I ((would)) have gotten it working without the key. All I needed was another hour. Possibly two. Seven at the very most.
Chinese: 你真是个扫兴鬼,你知道吗?没有钥匙我((也))能把它弄转起来。我只需要再一个小时。可能两个。最多七个。

English: <<Frost can't help grinning as his eyes dart wildly between each passing sight.>> ##Incredible. Simply ((astounding)). Imagine how these must have ((changed)) the very ((nature)) of distance. Entire populations, migrating like birds!
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特忍不住咧嘴笑,目光在掠过的景象间狂乱游移。>>##难以置信。简直是((奇迹)).想想这些一定曾((改变))了距离本身的((性质))。整整一城的人,像候鸟一样迁徙!

English: Well ((I'll be)). I've been to plenty o' places in my time - from the floating ziggurats of Al-Asfara to the glittering domes o' the Riovan council chambers. But this city... even in ((ruins)) it's a spectacle.
Chinese: 我的((老天))。我这一辈子去过不少地方——从阿尔-阿斯法拉的漂浮神塔,到里奥瓦议事厅闪光的穹顶。但这座城市……即便沦为((废墟)),也蔚为奇观。

English: <<He wipes his brow.>> Let's have a moment to take a breather. This city looks to be crawling with mechanical guards, so we need to have our wits about us.
Chinese: <<他擦了擦额头。>>咱们歇口气。这城里似乎爬满了机械卫兵,我们得打起十二分精神。

English: When you're ready, we'll head to the [[tallest tower]] over there. At its peak, the Duchess has scried some sort of [[autocoach]] that's angled towards the Cradle. Not gonna be an easy climb, but I ain't got any better ideas.
Chinese: 你准备好之后,我们就去那边那座[[最高的塔]]。女公爵窥到塔顶有一辆朝着摇篮方向的[[自动车厢]]。这一路爬上去不容易,但我也没有更好的主意。

English: Still, could be worse. ##<<He points at the slums beneath the city.>> At least we don't have to go ((down there)).
Chinese: 不过,也可能更糟。##<<他指向城下的贫民窟。>>至少我们不用去((那下面))。

English: I've erected another instance of my [[transpositional supply tent]]. Due to some clever cipher trickery, it can exist in two places at once, so you can use it to revisit the cutter crash site if you so desire.
Chinese: 我又立起了一顶[[置换补给帐篷]]。凭着某种巧妙的密文戏法,它能同时存在于两处,所以你若愿意,可以用它回到快艇坠毁的地方。

English: That said, I feel we should not linger any longer than we need to. Let's make our way through this dreadful city as quickly as we can.
Chinese: 话虽如此,我觉得我们不该作多余的逗留。让我们尽快穿过这座可怕的城市。

English: <<She fidgets in her armour, clearly restless.>> ##We're ((close)), Confessor. For better or worse we'll be upon Vela soon.
Chinese: <<她在铠甲中扭动,明显焦躁不安。>>##我们((快到了)),忏悔者。无论好坏,我们很快就会与薇拉照面。

English: But don't get careless. This city is a tangle of walkways, tunnels and crumbling masonry - it may take us a while to find a route through.
Chinese: 但别大意。这座城是步道、隧道和残垣的迷宫——我们可能要花些时间找路穿过去。

English: Looks like something big's up ahead. Let's not get careless.
Chinese: 前面似乎有个大东西。咱们别大意。

English: <<Frost is gawking around with innocent wonderment.>>
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特带着天真的惊叹四处张望。>>

English: Just ((look)) at that. You could fit my hometown's entire population into only a handful of these towers. How in the ((blazes)) did they support so many people?
Chinese: 你就((看看))那个吧。我家乡的全部人口塞进这几座塔都绰绰有余。他们到底是怎么((见鬼地))养活这么多人的?

English: <<He snaps his fingers, looking back at you with a wild surmise in his eyes.>> ##Of course. The ((autocoaches)). Move goods and labour to wherever it's needed at lightning speed.
Chinese: <<他打了个响指,回头看你,眼中闪着狂野的推测。>>##当然。((自动车厢)).以闪电般的速度,把货物和人力输送到任何需要的地方。

English: It all fits together, do you see? They could live in the countryside and work in the city, or vice versa. Devote whole buildings, whole ((towns)), to a single purpose, utterly specialised and optimised. The Clockwork Kingdom, perfected!
Chinese: 一切都对上了,你明白吗?他们可以住在乡下,去城里上班,或者反过来。把整栋建筑、整座((城镇))都献给单一目标,彻底专业化、最优化。发条王国的完美形态!

English: Hmph. We need to get to the [[top of this tower]], but seems like there's no staircase, and the elevator out there... <<He points at the exit.>> ...only goes ((down)).
Chinese: 哼。我们得登上这座[[塔顶]],但似乎没有楼梯,而外面的电梯……<<他指向出口。>>……只往((下))走。

English: Looks like we're gonna be taking a trip to those [[slums]] after all. Just my blasted luck.
Chinese: 看来我们终究得去那片[[贫民窟]]走一遭了。真是我那该死的运气。

English: It seems as though this is a theatre of some kind; how ((intriguing)). In the Endless Realm we're beset with playwrights and poets who make up for their lack of talent with an abundance of ((time)); it's strangely comforting to find a cultural parallel here.
Chinese: 这里似乎是一座剧院之类的场所;真((有趣)).在无尽领域,我们被剧作家和诗人包围,他们用充裕的((时间))弥补天赋的匮乏;在这里发现文化上的对应物,真是奇妙的安慰。

English: I wonder. Despite their grand achievements and innumerable luxuries, do Emberian poems still lament the basest of human follies? Do their tragedies still brim with pathos and regret?
Chinese: 我很好奇。尽管成就辉煌、穷奢极欲,余烬人的诗歌是否仍在哀叹人类最卑下的愚行?他们的悲剧是否仍满溢着哀婉与悔恨?

English: To think; this room once held hundreds of my ancestors united in merriment. I suppose this is the closest I've ever been to some sort of ((home)).
Chinese: 想想看;这间屋子曾容纳数百位我的祖先,一同欢庆。我想,这是我离某种((家))最近的一次。

English: And yet, among these rusting, empty seats - I've never felt more alone.
Chinese: 然而,坐在这生锈的空座椅之间——我从未感到如此孤独。

English: <<Frost whistles, then listens for the echo.>> ##Perfect acoustics. What is that ((creature))? A captive ghost? No; too clean. ((Mechanical)). An artificial player for a technological stage. How did they ((do)) it?
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特吹了声口哨,然后倾听回声。>>##完美的音响效果。那((造物))是什么?一只被囚禁的幽灵?不;太干净了。((机械)).为科技舞台造的人工演员。他们是((怎么))做到的?

English: ((Filch)) me, just think of the possibilities. Plays performed once, then reproduced elsewhere. Like a bottled vision without the solipsism. Hear the voices, see the passions of great actors long dead. Time no obstacle, distance no barrier!
Chinese: ((我的老天)),想想那可能性吧。一出戏上演一次,就能在别处重现。就像瓶装幻象,却没有唯我论。聆听早已作古的伟大演员的嗓音,目睹他们的激情。时间不再是阻碍,距离不再是屏障!

English: Was this a place of mere entertainment, or of worship too? Did art take the place of sacrament in uniting the masses? What did this place ((mean)) to the audience? Did they dress up finely, or come as they were?
Chinese: 这里仅仅是娱乐场所,还是也用于膜拜?艺术是否取代圣礼,凝聚了大众?这地方对观众而言((意味))着什么?他们盛装而来,还是素面朝天?

English: ((Confound)) it, if only I could spend a month in each of these buildings!
Chinese: ((该死)),真希望我能在每栋建筑里都待上一个月!

English: These are the deplorable slums of the Emberian underclasses. Many think every Emberian must have lived like a king, but they built their sprawling cities from the blood and sweat of the poor.
Chinese: 这些是余烬人底层阶级的贫民窟。许多人以为每个余烬人都过得像国王,但他们的辽阔城市是用穷人的血汗筑成的。

English: With such technological prowess, the Emberians could have built a paradise for every person in their empire. But I think they ((enjoyed)) the disparity. After all, for one to be considered rich, another must be destitute.
Chinese: 以如此的技术实力,余烬人本可以为帝国里的每个人建一座乐园。但我想他们((乐于))见到这种悬殊。毕竟,要让一人称富,必得另一人赤贫。

English: It's why I could never quite believe in Vela's ambition. Call me a cynic, but... paradise is only for the periodicals. In truth, we'll always be scrambling in the mud.
Chinese: 所以我始终无法完全相信薇拉的抱负。说我愤世嫉俗也罢,但……乐园只存在于杂志上。说到底,我们永远都会在泥里打滚。

English: As a child I would stare down from Verdant, past the clouds below, to the shimmering ocean of light that was the Emberian empire.
Chinese: 孩提时,我会从翠绿之地向下凝望,越过脚下的云层,望向那片波光粼粼的光之海洋——余烬帝国。

English: I believed that every man, woman and child must have gone to bed with a full belly. It's strange to see that in fact, they had their serfs and peasants just the same.
Chinese: 我曾以为,那里的每个男人、女人和孩子都会吃饱了上床睡觉。如今才知他们也一样有农奴和佃农,真叫人感慨。

English: Looks like this shaft leads back to the [[coach house]]. Use it if you need to resupply, but try no to linger; we've got a ways to go yet.
Chinese: 看来这条竖井通回[[车厢库]].需要补给就用它,但别久留;我们还有路要走。

English: Last I saw him, Frost was repairing an [[elevator]] at the base of one of those [[giant towers]]. If it works, that should get us where we need to go
Chinese: 我最后一次见到他时,弗罗斯特正在其中一座[[巨塔]]脚下修[[电梯]].若修好了,那就能带我们去要去的地方

English: No keys necessary this time, Confessor. I've applied the lessons of my inconclusive struggle with the autocoach to this recalcitrant [[elevator]], and it proved no match for Caxton Frost! I mean, Horace Metcalfe.
Chinese: 这次不需要钥匙了,忏悔者。我把与自动车厢那场未有定论的搏斗中学到的经验,用在了这台蛮不讲理的[[电梯]]上,事实证明它根本不是卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特的对手!我是说,霍勒斯·梅特卡夫。

English: When you throw the lever, we shall soar like dragonflies up to the highest peaks of this metropolis. Or possibly be catapulted, if I've misjudged the velocity. ((Blow)) me, this is exhilarating!
Chinese: 当你扳下操纵杆,我们将像蜻蜓一样飞上这座都会的最高峰。或者,若我算错了速度,也可能被弹射出去。((老天)),这真令人振奋!

English: See the [[tallest tower]] over yonder, Confessor? I've scried an autocoach at its peak that should take us to the Cradle.
Chinese: 看见那边那座[[最高的塔]]了吗,忏悔者?我在塔顶窥到一辆自动车厢,应该能带我们去摇篮。

English: Be careful making your way across. These platforms look awfully unsteady, and it's a ((long)) way down, eh?
Chinese: 穿过去的时候小心点。这些平台看着摇摇晃晃,而且下面可是((很))深的,嗯?

English: <<Frost is craning his neck to examine the ornamented ceiling.>> ##The markings are intriguing. Elaborate, yet entirely abstract. No apparent representation of figures or scenes.
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特伸长脖子,端详着雕饰的天花板。>>##这些纹样耐人寻味。繁复,却全然抽象。没有明显的人物或场景描绘。

English: Perhaps the Emberians held mathematics and geometry in higher respect than myth? ##No doubt this pattern had some ritual significance.
Chinese: 或许余烬人对数学与几何的尊崇胜过神话?##毫无疑问,这图案有某种仪式意义。

English: Well, here we are at last; the ((Cradle)). Looks like no alehouse ((I've)) ever seen... <<He chuckles.>>
Chinese: 好了,我们终于到了;((摇篮)).看上去可不像((我))见过的任何酒馆……<<他轻笑。>>

English: This platform should take us inside. When we get to Vela, you can do the talkin', Confessor; I reckon that's the best chance we've got. If she sees the rest of us, she'll only want to talk with her ((swords)) - what with us being ((mutineers)) an' all.
Chinese: 这个平台应该能带我们进去。见到薇拉时,由你来谈,忏悔者;我看这是我们最好的机会。她若看见我们其余几个,就只想用她的((剑))来谈了——毕竟我们是((叛徒))嘛。

English: I'm guessin' your superiors want her brought in quietly, but if things go south - an' I'm betting they ((will)) - we'll have your back. ##There may only be a handful of us, but we've faced tough odds before.
Chinese: 我猜你的上司想让她悄无声息地落网,但若事态有变——我打赌((会))——我们会给你撑腰。##我们人虽不多,但硬仗也打过。

English: <<He sighs.>> Oh, I ((hope)) it'll be that easy, Confessor. For our sake... an' for Vela's.
Chinese: <<他叹息。>>唉,我((希望))事情能那么简单,忏悔者。为了我们……也为了薇拉。

English: Just know that if she tries to slit yer throat, we'll be ready to jump in.
Chinese: 你只需知道,她若想割你的喉咙,我们随时准备冲上去。

English: <<He nods.>> That ain't such a bad idea. She'll have plenty of loyal Dark Stars with her, so we'll want to plan our attack. Just keep her talkin' long enough.
Chinese: <<他点头。>>这主意不算坏。她身边会有一大批忠诚的黑星,所以我们得计划好进攻。你只需拖住她说话,拖得够久。

English: <<He frowns.>> I hope for ((y'er)) sake you're jokin', ((Confessor)). We 'aint trifling with petty crimes, here - Vela could tear this world ((asunder)).
Chinese: <<他皱眉。>>看在((你))自己的份上,我希望你在开玩笑,((忏悔者)).我们在这里可不是闹着玩的小打小闹——薇拉能把这个世界((撕成两半))。

English: An' if you want to ((help)) her do it, then you'll be facing my blade before you do.
Chinese: 而你若想((帮))她这么做,那你得先过我这把刀。

English: I'll talk Vela into coming quietly.
Chinese: 我会说服薇拉乖乖就范。

English: I'll distract her while you get ready to strike.
Chinese: 我去引开她的注意,你们准备动手。

English: I'll hear her out. Maybe this plan of hers isn't so bad.
Chinese: 我会听她把话说完。也许她的计划没那么糟。

English: I'm going to offer Vela my undivided assistance.
Chinese: 我打算全力协助薇拉。

English: Oh my - this Cradle really is enormous, isn't it? I'm sure even the stonemasons who built our Endless mausoleums would break a sweat at the sight of ((this)).
Chinese: 天哪——这摇篮真是庞大,不是吗?我确信,就连建造我们无尽陵墓的石匠见了((这个))也会捏一把汗。

English: Being here makes my stomach churn. But make no mistake; my sword will swing true.
Chinese: 待在这里让我翻胃。但别搞错;我的剑不会偏。

English: If it were up to me, I'd rush Vela head on. Give her no time to ((think)) before I cleave her in two...
Chinese: 若由我做主,我会正面冲向薇拉。不给她((思考))的时间,直接把她劈成两半……

English: But Basalt thinks we should hold back - assess the situation while you two have a little ((chat)). An' loath as I am to admit it, the bastard's usually ((right)).
Chinese: 但巴索特觉得我们应该按兵不动——趁你们俩((聊聊))的时候看清局势。虽然我很不情愿承认,但这混蛋通常((是对的))。

English: <<Frost is staring at the Cradle in silent awe, his former exuberance stopped dead in its tracks.>>
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特沉默而敬畏地凝视着摇篮,先前的意气风发戛然而止。>>

English: I... um. Er.
Chinese: 我……呃。嗯。

English: Please forgive my ineloquence. I find myself quite overcome.
Chinese: 请原谅我笨嘴拙舌。我实在有些情难自已。

English: <<He pauses for a while as he mulls his words.>>
Chinese: <<他停顿片刻,斟酌着措辞。>>

English: In matters of religion, Confessor, I am my father's son. And my mother's, for that matter. Apostates to the end, they fled their homeland rather than truckle to any god.
Chinese: 在宗教一事上,忏悔者,我是我父亲的儿子。也是我母亲的。他们至死都是背教者,宁可逃离故土,也不向任何神明低头。

English: But... this place. The power, the industry, the ((knowledge)) that its existence represents... ##I can find no other word for it but 'holy'.
Chinese: 可……这个地方。它的存在所代表的力量、工业、((知识))……##除了"神圣",我找不出别的词来形容。

English: Is ((this)) what the devout feel towards their gods?
Chinese: 虔信者对诸神的感觉,((就))是这样吗?

English: <<You stand there in silence together for a minute or two, gazing at the Cradle.>>
Chinese: <<你们一同静立了一两分钟,凝望着摇篮。>>

English: What's the matter?
Chinese: 怎么了?

English: Aye. Me too.
Chinese: 是啊。我也有同感。

English: <<The gargantuan creature looming overhead seems to emit a dread energy - a nauseating force that makes your bones shiver and your mind warp.>>
Chinese: <<头顶那庞然巨物似乎散发着一种可怖的能量——一股令人作呕的力量,让你的骨髓战栗,心智扭曲。>>

English: <<The figure looks around frantically, shielding its eyes all the while.>>
Chinese: <<那身影疯狂地四下张望,一直遮着眼睛。>>

English: My son! Have you seen my son? I lost him in the crowds, and I can't hear him through the screaming...
Chinese: 我儿子!你见过我儿子吗?我在人群里把他弄丢了,尖叫声里我听不见他的声音……

English: <<The figure's head jerks towards you.>> ##This is no time for foolishness! The whole city flees, and my son was swept up in the commotion. If you won't help, get out of my way.
Chinese: <<那身影的头猛地转向你。>>##没时间胡闹!全城都在逃难,我儿子被卷进了骚乱。你若不肯帮忙,就别挡路。

English: My son! My only son is lost... and... ##<<The figure hunches, convulses, speaking through sobs...>>
Chinese: 我儿子!我唯一的儿子丢了……而……##<<那身影蜷起身子,抽搐着,泣不成声……>>

English: And I don't want us to die alone...
Chinese: 我不想我们孤零零地死去……

English: Crowds? Screaming? There's nobody here.
Chinese: 人群?尖叫?这里一个人也没有。

English: What are you so afraid of?
Chinese: 你到底在怕什么?

English: I... hope you find your son.
Chinese: 我……希望你找到你儿子。

English: Greetings again, stranger. I... don't suppose you would like to see a play, before I become inoperative?
Chinese: 又见面了,陌生人。我……不知道你是否愿意在我停机之前,看一出戏?

English: Ah, welcome patron! Please, take your seat. The show will begin sh--
Chinese: 啊,欢迎光临,贵客!请入座。演出马上就要开--

English: <<The figure freezes. Though its face resembles a statue, it conveys a sudden horror.>>
Chinese: <<那身影僵住了。虽然它的脸像一尊雕像,却流露出一瞬的惊恐。>>

English: Cipher network... severed? Power generators... offline. City population... ((five))? ##No... no, no no... this isn't possible...
Chinese: 密文网络……断开?发电机……离线。城市人口……((五))?##不……不,不不……这不可能……

English: Don't be ridiculous, it's been... ##<<It hesitates a moment, while its eyes dart between invisible targets.>>
Chinese: 别开玩笑了,已经……##<<它迟疑了片刻,目光在看不见的目标间来回游移。>>

English: It's been... ((many)) human lifetimes since I was last summoned...
Chinese: 距我上次被唤起,已经过了……((许多))个人生……

English: ((Everyone?)) But half a million souls dwell here! Half a million... gone?
Chinese: ((所有人?))可这里住着五十万生灵!五十万……没了?

English: This makes no sense. What of the rest of the Emberian Empire? Why have they not sent aid?
Chinese: 这说不通。余烬帝国其他地方呢?他们为何不来救援?

English: But that's impossible. To bring down the Empire would require an event of colossal destruction! Something more powerful than even a --
Chinese: 但那不可能。要毁掉帝国,需要一场毁天灭地的浩劫!得是比一个……还要强大的东西——

English: The Empire would not leave this city to rot. Never! But that means... ##<<The figure looks around at the sickly sky and the shattered horizon.>>
Chinese: 帝国不会任由这座城市腐烂。绝不会!但那就意味着……##<<那身影环顾病态的天空和破碎的地平线。>>

English: ...It can't be. The Empire ((can't)) have been destroyed. That would require something more powerful than even a --
Chinese: ……不可能。帝国((不可能))被毁。那得需要比一个……还要强大的东西——

English: <<They hesitate a moment, as if lost in some revelation.>> ##More powerful than a god.
Chinese: <<它迟疑了片刻,仿佛陷入某种顿悟。>>##比一位神更强大。

English: Then the naysayers were right. The Cradle was cursed, and those cipher scribes brought nought but doom.
Chinese: 那么唱反调的人是对的。摇篮受了诅咒,那些密文誊写师带来的只有毁灭。

English: You can see it outside. ##Part ship, part laboratory. The best and brightest have been toiling away at it for years.
Chinese: 你在外面就能看见它。##一半是船,一半是实验室。最优秀、最聪明的人已经为它辛苦多年。

English: It is a marvel of cipher-science, supposed to usher in a new age of human advancement. It is said to hold an entity of staggering power.
Chinese: 它是密文科学的奇迹,本应开启人类进步的新纪元。据说其中囚禁着一个力量骇人的实体。

English: Well, the autocoaches are clearly out of service, so you would need to teleport between the transit-crystals.
Chinese: 嗯,自动车厢显然已经停运,所以你需要在传送水晶之间传送。

English: There seems to be only one teleport spell left in the city. Longitude: three-seven-six, latitude: five-nine. ##That's... an old war bunker, deep underground.
Chinese: 全城似乎只剩一道传送咒了。经度:三七六,纬度:五九。##那是……一座古老的战争地堡,在很深的地下。

English: My records indicate it can be accessed through the city's underground tunnels... and from a secret passage in the library. ##But that's the extent of my knowledge on the matter.
Chinese: 我的记录显示,可以通过城市的地下隧道进入……以及图书馆里的一条密道。##我所知仅限于此了。

English: I am required to inform you that only individuals of Class-C and above are permitted to use teleport cipher-spells. ##But... I suppose that doesn't matter, now.
Chinese: 我有义务告知你,只有C级及以上人员才允许使用传送密文咒。##不过……我想现在已经无所谓了。

English: That is a question many want to know, but the Supervisors have it under lock and key. Clearance is for Class-A individuals only.
Chinese: 这是许多人都想知道的问题,但监督者们把它锁得死死的。权限仅限A级人员。

English: Still... whispers have slipped out from the Symposium. That they are constructing something of terrible potential, that could remake the world anew.
Chinese: 不过……还是有风声从研讨学会漏了出来。说他们在建造某种潜藏恐怖之物,能把世界彻底重塑。

English: For spreading such rumours, I would normally be destroyed. But I suppose my supervisor is in no such position to do so. ##It is oddly liberating, to speak so freely.
Chinese: 传播这样的谣言,我通常会被销毁。但我想我的监督者如今已经无力这么做了。##能如此畅所欲言,真是奇妙的解脱。

English: And I am obliged to answer all queries.
Chinese: 而我有义务回答所有询问。

English: What am... I? Forgive my surprise, I have never been asked such a question. Times must truly have changed.
Chinese: 我是什么?请原谅我的惊讶,从未有人问过我这样的问题。时代想必真的变了。

English: I am an avatar of the Emberian Empire. A construct of cipher, designed to simulate a human personality. I exist to serve the needs and whims of the populace.
Chinese: 我是余烬帝国的化身。一件密文造物,设计用来模拟人类人格。我存在的意义,是服务民众的需求与心血来潮。

English: Here, I run this amphitheatre. I was selected for my love and knowledge of drama. I have memorised a hundred plays, and can perform them by visualising a cast of spectral actors.
Chinese: 在这里,我运营这座圆形剧场。我因对戏剧的热爱与学识而被选中。我熟记一百出戏,能通过构想一群幽灵演员来演出它们。

English: But, my connection to the cipher-network has been severed. My power source dwindles, and I can already feel my cipher logic degrading.
Chinese: 但我与密文网络的连接已被切断。我的能源日渐枯竭,我已经能感觉到我的密文逻辑在退化。

English: It is strange. I have recited profundities on death and mortality a thousand-fold, yet I still do not feel... ready.
Chinese: 真奇怪。我背诵过千百遍关于死亡与终局的高深台词,却仍不觉得……做好了准备。

English: Albertus is the third-largest city in Emberia, and the sixth largest of the wider empire. ##Or, I suppose it... ((was)).
Chinese: 阿尔贝图斯是余烬的第三大城市,在全帝国排第六。##或者说,它((曾))是。

English: It was a city known for its scientific prowess. Every day, thousands of people clogged the autocoach networks, commuting to their labour halls. Every day, the cipher-network was refined and expanded for the betterment of the Empire.
Chinese: 它曾是一座以科学实力闻名的城市。每天,成千上万的人挤满自动车厢网络,通勤去各自的劳作厅。每天,密文网络都在为帝国的福祉而精进和扩张。

English: It was said this city would prosper for a thousand years.
Chinese: 据说这座城市会繁荣一千年。

English: As you wish.
Chinese: 如你所愿。

English: <<The avatar's face is impassive, but you'd swear you hear a scintilla of sorrow in its voice.>> ##As you wish. Please enjoy our fair city.
Chinese: <<化身的面孔毫无表情,但你敢发誓,你在它的声音里听见了一丝哀伤。>>##如你所愿。请欣赏我们美丽的城市。

English: Be calm. Whatever happened here, happened long ago.
Chinese: 冷静。无论这里发生过什么,都是很久以前的事了。

English: Yup, everyone here is very much dead.
Chinese: 对,这里所有人都死透了。

English: The Emberians are dead. The planet's surface is nothing but ash.
Chinese: 余烬人都死了。星球表面只剩灰烬。

English: You're Emberian, right? Why can't ((you)) tell ((me?))
Chinese: 你是余烬人,对吧?为什么((你))不能告诉((我?))

English: Wait, did you say Cradle?
Chinese: 等等,你是说摇篮?

English: Tell me more about the Cradle.
Chinese: 多跟我讲讲摇篮。

English: I have questions about this place...
Chinese: 关于这个地方我有问题……

English: I'd better get going.
Chinese: 我最好走了。

English: I need to get up there. Can you help?
Chinese: 我得上去。你能帮忙吗?

English: What's inside the Cradle?
Chinese: 摇篮里面有什么?

English: I have other questions I want to ask you.
Chinese: 我还有别的问题想问你。

English: What are you?
Chinese: 你是什么?

English: Can you tell me about this city?
Chinese: 你能跟我讲讲这座城市吗?

English: That's all I wanted to know.
Chinese: 我想了解的就这些了。

English: This damned autocoach is late ((again!)) I ((can't)) be late. I'm behind on my quota! I could have my class-rank degraded... oh, gods...
Chinese: 这该死的自动车厢又((晚了!))我((不能))迟到。我的定额已经落后了!我的阶级等级可能会被降级……哦,神啊……

English: The driver's late - ((again)) - so the doors are locked tight.
Chinese: 司机迟到了——((又))是——所以车门锁得死死的。

English: You'd need at least a Class-C security pass to bypass those doors. Not that you'd find any Class-C citizens rubbing shoulders with us commuters - they'll be in the noble district, admiring the mushroom horticulture.
Chinese: 你至少需要C级通行证才能绕过那些门。不过你也不会找到哪个C级公民跟我们这些通勤者挤在一起——他们都在贵族区,欣赏蘑菇园艺呢。

English: Hmm? What nonsense are you talking about? I work for one of the premiere cipher-spell combines in the Empire, and they have ((high standards!))
Chinese: 嗯?你在胡说什么?我为帝国顶尖的密文咒联合企业之一工作,他们的((标准很高!))

English: <<The figure looks around suddenly.>> ##Wait, what's that light? It's getting awfully hot in here...
Chinese: <<那身影突然环顾四周。>>##等等,那是什么光?这里热得吓人……

English: I need to get past this carriage. Any ideas?
Chinese: 我得穿过这节车厢。有什么主意吗?

English: I'm not sure your employers will mind, seeing as they're dead.
Chinese: 我觉得你的雇主们不会介意,毕竟他们都死了。

English: Good luck with that.
Chinese: 祝你好运。

English: <<Vela stands with poise, her commands booming through the chamber as Dark Star mercenaries scurry at her beck and call.>>
Chinese: <<薇拉从容而立,她的号令在大厅中轰然回响,黑星佣兵们随传随到、四处奔走。>>

English: <<Vela's head snaps around, her eyes fixed upon you. She turns with one hand on her sword hilt.>>
Chinese: <<薇拉的头猛地转过来,双眼锁定你。她一手按在剑柄上,转过身来。>>

English: <<You creep towards Vela, your soft steps muffled by the clamour. You're nearly close enough to intervene when her head snaps around; her eyes fixed upon you.>>
Chinese: <<你悄悄逼近薇拉,轻缓的脚步被嘈杂掩盖。你几乎近到可以出手,她的头却猛地转了过来;双眼锁定你。>>

English: ((Silence!)) <<Vela's voice cuts through the air, her piercing gaze meeting your own.>>
Chinese: ((肃静!))<<薇拉的声音划破空气,锐利的目光与你相接。>>

English: An intruder? ((Here?)) We're ((leagues)) under the Skyrealms, in a place as dangerous as it is inhospitable. You must be incredibly capable or ((extremely)) stupid to follow me here.
Chinese: 不速之客?((在这里?))我们在天空领域之下((数千里格))的地方,一处既危险又不宜居之地。能跟到这里,你要么本领惊人,要么((蠢得))出奇。

English: <<She squints.>> Hold on - you're that whelp who had the ((gall)) to approach me on the Blinding Light, aren't you?  ##<<A thin smile spreads across her lips.>> My, you've had quite the journey, inquisitor. I almost didn't recognise you.
Chinese: <<她眯起眼。>>等等——你就是那个((胆敢))在炫光要塞上接近我的小崽子,对吧?##<<一抹浅笑爬上她的嘴角。>>哎呀,你这趟旅程不短啊,审判官。我差点没认出你。

English: But you must have had help. <<She ponders a moment.>> ##Only Orlaith saw the map that led here. She wouldn't have decided to come on her own - so Basalt must have convinced her.
Chinese: 但你一定有人相助。<<她思忖片刻。>>##只有奥莱丝见过通往这里的地图。她不会自己决定前来——所以一定是巴索特说服了她。

English: And if he was putting a team together, Caxton Frost would be top of that list. Maybe the Duchess as well...
Chinese: 而他若在组队,卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特必在名单之首。也许还有女公爵……

English: <<She shakes her head.>> But it can't just be Basalt leading this. He'd never have joined the Inquisition without persuasion. It can only be... ((Caer)).
Chinese: <<她摇头。>>但这不可能只是巴索特在牵头。不经劝说,他绝不会加入宗教裁判所。只可能是……((凯尔))。

English: You don't deny it? <<She grins.>> ##So, a pack of traitors, led by a fledgling Inquisitor, have come to nip at my heels. Tell me - just ((what)) are you hoping to achieve?
Chinese: 你不否认?<<她咧嘴笑。>>##所以,一伙叛徒,在一个初出茅庐的审判官带领下,跑来咬我的脚后跟了。告诉我——你们究竟((想))达到什么目的?

English: ((Madness?)) Hah! Is ((that)) what they claim? ##It is the people of the ((Skyrealms)) who have lost all sense of reason. I only seek to put things right.
Chinese: ((疯狂?))哈!他们((就))这么说的?##失去理智的是((天空领域))的人民。我只是在拨乱反正。

English: <<She lets out an impertinent laugh.>> And why would I trust the likes of ((you))? Even if I needed assistance - which I most certainly ((do not)) - why would I accept it from an Inquisition spy?
Chinese: <<她放肆地大笑。>>我为什么要相信((你))这种人?就算我需要援助——我((当然不需要))——我为什么要接受一个宗教裁判所间谍的援助?

English: So at the first chance you would resort to violence and barbarism? <<She tuts theatrically.>> ##Such self-involved thinking is what's ((wrong)) with this world.
Chinese: 所以一有机会你就会诉诸暴力与野蛮?<<她戏剧性地啧啧两声。>>##这种只顾自己的想法,正是这个世界((错))的地方。

English: <<She gestures at the aberrant being that fills your vision.>> ##((This)) extraordinary entity will be our salvation. It will mend our broken world and abolish the evils of humanity.
Chinese: <<她指向占满你视野的那个异变存在。>>##((这位))非凡的实体将是我们的救赎。它将修补我们破碎的世界,涤除人类的罪恶。

English: All we need do is ((awaken)) it, and we are so ((nearly)) ready.
Chinese: 我们只需((唤醒))它,而我们已((几乎))准备就绪。

English: Some would call it a ((god)) - but that would be to diminish its power, for the gods are of ((this)) world and are bound by ((its)) rules.
Chinese: 有人会称它为((神))——但那是贬低了它的力量,因为神属于((这个))世界,受((其))规则约束。

English: This being is of the ((void)): the non-place of pure creation, where time and space act in mysterious ways. We know not whether the Emberians plucked it whole from that realm, or wove its corporeal flesh from voidstuff.
Chinese: 这存在来自((虚空)):纯粹创造的无何有之乡,时间与空间以神秘的方式运作其中。我们不知道余烬人是把它从那个领域整个摘来,还是用虚空质编织了它的血肉之躯。

English: Regardless, in the ancient Emberian dialect they called it an [[Angel]] - after the mythical creatures of middle age lore.
Chinese: 无论如何,在古老的余烬方言里,他们称它为[[天使]]——取自中世纪传说中的神兽。

English: Reality is formed from the semiotics of cipher. It is the language that flows through all things; the ((truth)) behind the illusion that dances before our eyes.
Chinese: 现实由密文的符号学构成。它是流经万物的语言;是眼前幻象之舞背后的((真相))。

English: With study, we may learn to alter its flow, its rhythm. We may tweak a word here, adjust a sentence there, and this is the basis of all magic.
Chinese: 通过研习,我们可以学会改变它的流动、它的韵律。在这里改一个词,在那里调一句,这便是一切魔法的根基。

English: What we cannot do is alter the language of cipher itself. There are strict rules by which we must adhere; absolute and unbreakable limits upon what is possible.
Chinese: 我们做不到的,是改动密文语言本身。有些严格的规则我们必须遵守;对可能性有着绝对不可逾越的限制。

English: But this entity that stands before us? Being of the void, it is fundamentally separate from our laws. It has the power to change the very ((essence)) of reality.
Chinese: 但眼前这位实体呢?身为虚空之物,它在根本上独立于我们的法则。它拥有改变现实((本源))的力量。

English: <<She grins.>> I am going to change ((everything)).
Chinese: <<她咧嘴笑。>>我要改变((一切))。

English: <<She grins.>> The process is not without its dangers.
Chinese: <<她咧嘴笑。>>这一过程并非毫无危险。

English: The Emberians called this thing an [[Angel]], and had they succeeded in waking it, their tyranny would have enslaved the world for eternity.
Chinese: 余烬人称这东西为[[天使]],若他们成功唤醒了它,他们的暴政将永世奴役世界。

English: The Emberians built this structure as an incubator for the Angel, and had they succeeded in waking it, their tyranny would have enslaved the world for eternity.
Chinese: 余烬人建起这座巨构,作为天使的孵化器,若他们成功唤醒了它,他们的暴政将永世奴役世界。

English: We're fortunate that the ((lesser)) evil occurred; for in stirring the Angel they caused the World Rend, and nearly obliterated all of existence.
Chinese: 我们幸运地只发生了((较轻))的恶;因为他们惊扰了天使,引发了世界撕裂,几乎抹除了一切存在。

English: But we have learned from their mistakes. We will use the Angel to turn this world into a Heaven, where every soul is free and equal.
Chinese: 但我们已从他们的错误中吸取教训。我们将用天使把这个世界变成一座天堂,让每个灵魂自由而平等。

English: Over the past few years I have recruited some of the most accomplished cipher scholars alive. With the correct warding we will prevent a syntax cascade. Of this we are... ((almost)) certain.
Chinese: 过去几年,我招募了在世最杰出的几位密文学者。只要护符正确,我们就能防止句法级联。这一点我们……((几乎))可以肯定。

English: And regardless, is the reward not worth the risk? What's left of this world is barely worth saving - but I would elevate us to something nobler than history has ever known.
Chinese: 再说,这奖赏难道不值这点风险吗?这世界剩下的东西几乎不值得拯救——但我要把我们提升到历史从未见识过的高贵境地。

English: You think yourself quite the philosopher, speaking in absolutes. But even if you were to define the ((freedom)) I would bestow as a sort of ((tyranny)), it would be vastly preferable to the current state of affairs.
Chinese: 你满口绝对之词,还自以为是哲学家。可就算你把我将赐予的((自由))定义为一种((暴政)),它也远比现状可取。

English: <<She scoffs.>> I do not need your ((praise)). I have been thinking of this, and little else, for so many years. I ((know)) it is worth the risk.
Chinese: <<她嗤笑。>>我不需要你的((赞美)).这么多年,我满脑子都是这件事,别的几乎什么都想不进去。我((知道))它值得冒险。

English: <<Her eyes glint as they look into your own.>> ##You see, inquisitor, there is such ((beauty)) in us. Such majesty, such ((potential)).
Chinese: <<她的目光与你的相接,闪着光。>>##你瞧,审判官,我们身上有那样的((美)).那样的庄严,那样的((潜力))。

English: I have sailed the Skyrealms and seen such wonders. ##<<She waves her hand.>> Nay, not the void-obelisks of Al-Asfara, or the thousand spires of Byonne university...
Chinese: 我航行过天空领域,见过那样的奇观。##<<她挥挥手。>>不,不是阿尔-阿斯法拉的虚空方尖碑,也不是拜昂大学的千座尖塔……

English: I have seen the nuns of the Vagrant Hospice, tending to their enemies. I have seen a man give his life to the blood-barons of Teren, so that a stranger might live.
Chinese: 我见过流浪者济贫院的修女,照料她们的仇敌。我见过一个人把自己献给特伦的血男爵,只为让一个陌生人活下去。

English: <<She sighs.>> I have seen a child - recently orphaned, her face speckled with blood - offer me the ((last)) of her bread.
Chinese: <<她叹息。>>我见过一个孩子——刚刚沦为孤儿,脸上溅着血点——把她仅剩的((最后))一块面包递给我。

English: <<She steps closer.>> But wherever my sails have taken me, I have seen the hopes and dreams of the common folk ((crushed)) by oppressors; be they Union, Wikkan or otherwise. Everywhere I go, the poor writhe in the mud so that the rich may sleep in silk.
Chinese: <<她走近一步。>>但无论我的帆带我到何处,我都见过平民的希望与梦想被压迫者((碾碎));无论联盟、维坎还是别的什么。我到处的所见,都是穷人在泥里翻滚,好让富人睡在丝绸里。

English: Once, I thought my sword could right the wrongs of the world - that ((morals)) and ((ethics)) could guide my blade. But I've seen too many skyships burn, and too often breathed the stench of human flesh, to believe that still.
Chinese: 曾经,我以为我的剑能匡正世界的冤屈——以为((道德))与((伦理))能为我的剑刃引路。但我见过太多飞船燃烧,太多次呼吸过人肉腐烂的恶臭,再也无法那么相信了。

English: In truth I had lost hope - until I had visions of an ((Angel)), through the oneiric interface of an Emberian map. I realised, then, what could be achieved.
Chinese: 说实话,我已失去希望——直到我透过一张余烬地图的梦境界面,看见了((天使))的幻象。那时我才明白,什么是可以实现的。

English: Oh, but with the Angel, we ((could)). It can change ((anything)) of this corporeal world... ##But don't look so aghast. It really needn't come to that.
Chinese: 哦,但有了天使,我们((就能)).它能改变这个物质世界的((任何))事……##但别摆出那副惊骇的样子。真不必走到那一步。

English: <<Her stare gains a fiery intensity.>> I would empower us ((all)), so that every peasant stands equal to their lord. I would blunt every sword, shatter every cannon - so that not a drop of blood would spill.
Chinese: <<她的凝视燃起炽烈的火。>>我要赋权于((我们所有人)),让每个农夫与领主平起平坐。我要钝化每一把剑,击碎每一门炮——让一滴血都不必流。

English: <<She looks down, her expression suddenly vulnerable.>> And... I would banish ((death itself)), so that no heart would ever be broken. ##((This)) will be our Heaven, and soon we will have it.
Chinese: <<她垂下目光,神情忽然变得脆弱。>>还有……我要放逐((死亡本身)),让任何一颗心都不再破碎。##((这))将是我们的天堂,很快我们就会拥有它。

English: <<She nods.>> A point of no return, beyond which no scryer can foresee. A labyrinth of possibility, incomprehensible to mortal minds...
Chinese: <<她点头。>>一个不归点,任何窥探者都无法预见其后。一座可能性的迷宫,凡人的心智无法理解……

English: But one must be willing to sail into the unknown if one wishes for real change. Better that, than to linger in certain suffering.
Chinese: 但人若想真正的改变,就必须敢于驶向未知。总好过在确凿的苦难里徘徊。

English: ((Freedom?)) What ((freedoms)) do we have, here in this broken world? Just because we can hack each other to pieces, it does not mean we are ((free)).
Chinese: ((自由?))在这个破碎的世界里,我们又有((什么))自由?就因为我们可以把彼此砍成碎片,不代表我们就是((自由))的。

English: And besides, anyone would be able to leave. If they wished to dissipate their essence to the void, along with their mind's eye, they could do so.
Chinese: 再说,任何人都可以离开。若有人想把自己的本质连同心眼一并散入虚空,他们尽可以那么做。

English: <<She grins.>> I suppose we're about to find out.
Chinese: <<她咧嘴笑。>>我想我们马上就会知道答案了。

English: Very soon, I will awaken the Angel. Not out of greed or selfishness, but for the ((betterment)) of the Skyrealms and its people.
Chinese: 很快,我就会唤醒天使。不是出于贪婪或私欲,而是为了天空领域及其人民的((福祉))。

English: <<Vela glares at you with a newfound fury.>> How ((dare)) you mention her name! You know ((nothing)) of her soul - of my ((family)).
Chinese: <<薇拉带着前所未有的怒火瞪着你。>>你((怎敢))提起她的名字!你对她的灵魂((一无所知))——对我的((家人))一无所知。

English: Isabet was... she meant more to me than... ##<<Vela closes her eyes for a long moment.>>
Chinese: 伊莎贝特她……她对我而言,比……##<<薇拉闭了很久的眼睛。>>

English: Isabet and my mother ((burned alive)) in my father's mansion. That Isabet was taken so young, and I alone should live, speaks plainly of the injustice of this world. Am I ((wrong)) for wanting to change that?
Chinese: 伊莎贝特和我母亲在我父亲的宅邸里((被活活烧死)).伊莎贝特那么年轻就殒命,而我独独活了下来,这明明白白诉说着这个世界的不公。想改变这一切,我((错))了吗?

English: <<Vela stutters, now stumbling over her words.>> ##Caer... ((betrayed)) me. I... I would have given my ((life)) for that girl, but she... She...
Chinese: <<薇拉结巴起来,话语磕磕绊绊。>>##凯尔……((背叛))了我。我……我本可以为那个女孩献出((生命)),可她……她……

English: %% I... they... ((traitors)), all! If only they had ((listened)), instead of... instead of... ##I didn't ((wish)) for them to die!
Chinese: %%我……他们……全是((叛徒))!要是他们肯((听我的)),而不是……而不是……##我没((想))让他们死!

English: && Pah. Those ((traitors)) could have left of their own accord. They had no reason to ((fight)) me - I'm sure I would have let them go peacefully.
Chinese: &&呸。那些((叛徒))本可以自行离开。他们没有任何理由((与我))为敌——我肯定会让她们平静地走的。

English: <<Vela's face burns with sudden contempt.>> ##Then you should have kept your mouth ((shut)). However you found this out, I do not care for you raking through my past like a haruspex through offal.
Chinese: <<薇拉脸上骤然燃起轻蔑。>>##那你就该管好自己的((嘴)).不管你是怎么查到的,我可不喜欢你像肠卜师翻检内脏一样翻我的过去。

English: <<Vela frowns.>> A ((ghost))? But who knows about...? No, it couldn't be...
Chinese: <<薇拉皱眉。>>一个((幽灵))?可谁知道那件事……?不,不可能是……

English: ...((Caer?)) ##<<She swallows, at a loss for words.>> ##Then she must have told you about...
Chinese: ……((凯尔?))##<<她咽了口唾沫,一时语塞。>>##那她一定跟你说了……

English: <<She laughs.>> Oh no, little inquisitor. This is where it ((begins)).
Chinese: <<她大笑。>>哦不,小审判官。好戏这才((开始))。

English: <<She grins.>> That's either the most obvious Inquisition cover story I've ever heard, or an unusually adroit triple bluff. Nothing personal, but I can't risk letting you tag along.
Chinese: <<她咧嘴笑。>>这要么是我听过最露骨的宗教裁判所幌子,要么是一次异常老练的三重欺诈。非针对你,但我不能冒险让你跟来。

English: <<Vela swallows, trying to find her composure.>> I'll admit, my motives are complicated. And my methods...
Chinese: <<薇拉咽了口唾沫,竭力找回镇定。>>我承认,我的动机很复杂。而我的手段……
