English: <<She gives you a twisted, almost regretful smile.>> ##Had I done this for any lesser cause, I'd be a monster.
Chinese: <<她给你一个扭曲的、近乎悔恨的微笑。>>##若我为任何低微一些的目标做这一切,我就是个怪物。

English: <<Vela bellows to her crew.>> ##((Awaken the Angel!)) I don't ((care)) if the preparations aren't complete, we have ((run out of time!))
Chinese: <<薇拉朝她的船员怒吼。>>##((唤醒天使!))我((不管))准备是否完备,我们已经((没有时间了!))

English: <<Her eyes return to you.>> ##I'm terribly sorry about this. I wish there was another way, but there isn't.
Chinese: <<她的目光回到你身上。>>##对此我万分抱歉。我多希望还有别的办法,可是没有。

English: The coming days are crucial. Now that it's awake, we have many delicate rituals and cipher wards to enact, and you cannot be allowed to meddle in such a ((momentous)) endeavour.
Chinese: 接下来的日子至关重要。既然它已经苏醒,我们还有许多精细的仪式和密文护符要施行,决不能让你插手如此((重大))的事业。

English: So I'm afraid this is goodbye. We will ((not)) meet again.
Chinese: 所以恐怕这就是告别了。我们((不会))再见了。

English: <<From behind you, you hear Jack Basalt yelling at the top of his lungs.>> ##Vela, ((no))!
Chinese: <<你听见身后杰克·巴索特扯着嗓子大喊。>>##薇拉,((不))!

English: <<From behind you, you hear Jack Basalt yelling at the top of his lungs.>>
Chinese: <<你听见身后杰克·巴索特扯着嗓子大喊。>>

English: Vela, ((no))!
Vela Callose!
Chinese: 薇拉·卡洛斯!

English: <<[Attempt to approach silently.]>>
Chinese: <<[尝试悄声接近。]>>

English: Vela Callose, I've come to -
Chinese: 薇拉·卡洛斯,我是来——

English: By order of the Inquisition, I -
Chinese: 奉宗教裁判所之命,我——

English: <<[Freeze and say nothing.]>>
Chinese: <<[僵在原地,一言不发。]>>

English: We've come to put an end to this, Vela. You must ((stop)) this madness!
Chinese: 我们是来终结这一切的,薇拉。你必须((停止))这场疯狂!

English: Your old friends helped me get here, but I've come to join your cause.
Chinese: 你的老朋友们帮我到了这里,但我是来加入你的事业的。

English: All I care about is my freedom. If I have to cut off your head, so be it.
Chinese: 我只在乎我的自由。若必须砍下你的脑袋,那便如此。

English: What ((is)) that thing?
Chinese: 那((究竟))是什么东西?

English: How is it so powerful?
Chinese: 它怎么这么强大?

English: What do you plan to do with it?
Chinese: 你打算用它做什么?

English: Waking it up seems like a ((terrible)) idea.
Chinese: 唤醒它似乎是个((糟透))了的主意。

English: You could spark a second apocalypse, and destroy what's left of our world.
Chinese: 你可能引发第二次天启,毁掉我们世界仅存的一切。

English: With the best of intentions, you would only make a tyranny of your own design.
Chinese: 哪怕怀着最好的初衷,你也只会打造一个由你设计的暴政。

English: I think you're right; a just and fair world is worth the risk.
Chinese: 我想你是对的;一个公正平等的世界值得一赌。

English: So you'd risk another World Rend just to give bread to the poor?
Chinese: 所以你宁愿再赌一次世界撕裂,只为给穷人一块面包?

English: You can't change human nature.
Chinese: 人性是无法改变的。

English: <<[Say nothing and listen.]>>
Chinese: <<[什么也不说,静静聆听。]>>

English: Sounds like madness. Even if it worked, ((everything)) would change.
Chinese: 听起来像疯了。就算成了,((一切))也都会改变。

English: You'd be taking away our freedom - to fight for something, even to ((die)).
Chinese: 你会夺走我们的自由——为某事而战的自由,甚至((赴死))的自由。

English: An admirable dream, but is it really possible?
Chinese: 一个令人钦佩的梦,但它真的可能吗?

English: And what of your late sister, Isabet? Are you sure you're not doing this for ((her))?
Chinese: 那你已故的妹妹伊莎贝特呢?你确定你不是在为((她))做这一切?

English: I met a certain ghost who told me that your motivations are more... ((personal)).
Chinese: 我遇见过某位幽灵,她说你的动机更加……((私人))。

English: Your ambition would doom us all. This ends ((now)), Vela.
Chinese: 你的野心会葬送我们所有人。一切到此((为止)),薇拉。

English: I want to help you, in any way I can.
Chinese: 我想帮你,尽我所能。

English: What about the people who suffered for your vision? People like Caer, who you left to ((die))?
Chinese: 那些为你的愿景受苦的人呢?像凯尔那样被你弃之((等死))的人?

English: @@ You don't speak for all. Many oppose you, even your own former Dark Stars.
Chinese: @@你可代表不了所有人。许多人反对你,连你从前的黑星同伴也是。

English: I meant no offence, Vela.
Chinese: 我没有冒犯的意思,薇拉。

English: It was Caer.
Chinese: 是凯尔。

English: ((Who)) it was doesn't matter. They told me about your late sister, Isabet.
Chinese: 是((谁))说的并不重要。他们跟我提过你已故的妹妹,伊莎贝特。

English: Isabet, yes.
Chinese: 伊莎贝特,是的。

English: Forget it, Vela. I meant no offence.
Chinese: 算了,薇拉。我没有冒犯的意思。

English: Well, this is it. One last daring push into Vela's maelstrom, eh? Only, this time, I fear there'll be no second chances.
Chinese: 好了,就是这里了。最后孤注一掷,冲进薇拉的漩涡,对吧?只是这次,恐怕没有第二次机会了。

English: <<He shoots you a serious look.>> It doesn't matter how many times that god of yours can pull you back from the dead. If Vela activates that ((abomination)), it's all over. ##Unless we can stop her, Vela will either rule the world or end it.
Chinese: <<他神情严肃地看着你。>>你那尊神能把你从死人堆里拉回来多少次都无所谓。薇拉若启动那个((可憎之物)),一切就完了。##除非我们能拦住她,否则薇拉要么统治世界,要么终结世界。

English: ((Damn)) that girl, for bringing it to this. She could've done great things, y'know? Her name could've gone down in history as a saviour, not a ((tyrant))...
Chinese: ((该死))的姑娘,把事情闹到这步田地。她本可以成就大业,你知道吗?她的名字本可以以救世主之名载入史册,而不是((暴君))……

English: The cutter's ready to depart, Confessor. You might wanna check with the rest 'o the crew to see how they're holdin' up firs... but otherwise, [[use the controls]] when you're ready.
Chinese: 快艇已经准备出发了,忏悔者。你或许该先去看看其他船员状态如何……不过除此之外,准备好了就[[使用控制装置]]。

English: Well, anyway. The cutter's ready to depart. You might wanna check with the rest 'o the crew to see how they're holdin' up firs... but otherwise, [[use the controls]] when you're ready.
Chinese: 总之,快艇已经准备出发。你或许该先去看看其他船员状态如何……不过除此之外,准备好了就[[使用控制装置]]。

English: Jus' make sure you're ((really)) ready, eh? Assaulting that Cradle is no easy task - this may just be the [[((last)) thing we ever do]].
Chinese: 只是务必确认你((真的))准备好了,嗯?强攻那座摇篮可不轻松——这搞不好就是[[((我们))此生做的最后一件大事]]。

English: The place is a fortress, too risky for a head-on assault. But if the Duchess could distract Vela's entourage with her magic, the rest of you might have a chance.
Chinese: 那地方就是座堡垒,正面强攻风险太大。但若女公爵能用魔法拖住薇拉的随从,你们其余人或许有机会。

English: Frost thinks he's spotted a [[back door]]: some sort of [[utility pipe]] that could be cracked open, giving you and Orlaith a way inside.
Chinese: 弗罗斯特觉得他发现了一道[[后门]]:某种[[公用管道]],可以撬开,给你和奥莱丝一条进入的路。

English: Then, Orlaith will head straight for Vela an' try to keep her busy. ##As for you? [[Find that Angel]] at all costs.
Chinese: 然后,奥莱丝直取薇拉,设法缠住她。##至于你?不惜一切代价[[找到那位天使]]。

English: Then, if all goes to plan, we'll meet up in the Cradle's centre and we can boot that Angel back to the Void. Piece of cake, eh?
Chinese: 然后,若一切按计划进行,我们就在摇篮中心会合,把那位天使一脚踹回虚空。小菜一碟,对吧?

English: What's the plan when we reach the Cradle?
Chinese: 到了摇篮之后有什么计划?

English: I'll get going.
Chinese: 我这就出发。

English: I'm ready to set sail when you are, Confessor. The sooner the better, in my book.
Chinese: 你一声令下我就准备启航,忏悔者。在我看来,越快越好。

English: <<Orlaith looks agitated, shifting in her armour.>> ##You know, I've faced up to impossible odds before. Always bested them. So why do I feel so godsdamned ((nervous))?
Chinese: <<奥莱丝看起来焦躁不安,在铠甲中扭动。>>##你知道,我以前直面过毫无胜算的战局。每次都赢了。那我为什么会((慌))成这样?

English: <<She looks at her hand; it's trembling slightly. She clenches it into a fist.>> ##I guess I've always looked up to Vela. She's saved me more times than I can count - so even though I ((know)) this is the right thing to do, my stomach's still churning.
Chinese: <<她看着自己的手;手在微微颤抖。她攥成拳头。>>##我想我一直敬仰薇拉。她救过我的次数数都数不清——所以即便我((知道))这样做是对的,我的胃还是翻腾不止。

English: <<She looks at you.>> Listen, Confessor... ##When we met, you told me we'd finish what I started - the mutiny against Vela - and stop her before she does the unthinkable.
Chinese: <<她看着你。>>听着,忏悔者……##我们初见时,你说过我们要完成我未竟之事——对薇拉的叛变——在她做出不可挽回之事前拦住她。

English: Do you stand by that? Do you really think we can ((do)) this?
Chinese: 你还坚持这话吗?你真觉得我们能((做到))?

English: <<She nods.>> I appreciate your confidence in me, Confessor.
Chinese: <<她点头。>>感谢你的信任,忏悔者。

English: <<She nods.>> Might not be what I was ((hopin')) to hear, but... I think you're right.
Chinese: <<她点头。>>可能不是我想((听))到的答案,但……我想你是对的。

English: <<She glares at you.>> With respect - what the ((fuck)), Confessor?
Chinese: <<她瞪着你。>>恕我直言——你搞什么((鬼)),忏悔者?

English: Gods know, Vela can be persuasive. I've heard that silver tongue of hers a thousand times. But we had a ((deal)), Confessor! I've followed you this far because I want to ((stop)) Vela, not aid in the destruction of the ((world)).
Chinese: 神知道,薇拉很能蛊惑人心。她那三寸不烂之舌我听过一千遍。但我们有((约定)),忏悔者!我跟你走到今天,是因为我想((阻止))薇拉,不是助她毁灭((世界))。

English: <<She scoffs.>> Well if you won't help me, I'll do it ((alone)). As soon as we get to the Cradle, I'm hunting down Vela - with or ((without)) you.
Chinese: <<她嗤笑。>>你若不肯帮我,我就((独自))去干。一踏上摇篮,我就去找薇拉算账——不管有没有((你))。

English: Listen, Confessor... ##When we met, you told me we'd stop Vela without bloodshed. I think we can safely say that we ((tried)) and ((failed)) in that regard, eh?
Chinese: 听着,忏悔者……##我们初见时,你说过要不流一滴血拦下薇拉。我想我们可以放心地说,这方面我们((试过))也((失败))了,嗯?

English: So this time, I ain't askin' questions; I'm letting my ((sword)) do the talking. You'd better be ((okay)) with that.
Chinese: 所以这一次,我不问问题;我让我的((剑))来发言。你最好((接受))这一点。

English: <<She grins.>> Do I hear a lust for ((revenge)) in your tone, Confessor? She ((did)) skewer you pretty good, back there...
Chinese: <<她咧嘴笑。>>我从你的语气里听出了((复仇))的渴望,忏悔者?她那一下((确实))把你扎得挺惨,在后面那里……

English: <<She sighs.>> It's not that simple. Once the swords start swinging, it's life or death. But... I'll give it my all.
Chinese: <<她叹气。>>没那么简单。刀剑一起挥,就是生死相搏。但……我会全力以赴。

English: Listen, Confessor... ##When we met, you said you wanted to ((help)) Vela achieve her twisted idea of Heaven. After speaking for her - after seeing what she's ((become)) - do you think that still?
Chinese: 听着,忏悔者……##我们初见时,你说你想((帮))薇拉实现她那扭曲的天堂。在替她说话之后——在亲眼见过她((变成))什么样之后——你还这么想吗?

English: <<She scoffs.>> After she skewered you through with her sword, I thought you might have had a change of heart. ((Damn)) Vela and that silver tongue of hers.
Chinese: <<她嗤笑。>>她一剑把你穿了个透心凉,我还以为你会回心转意。((该死))的薇拉和她那条三寸不烂之舌。

English: Well if you won't help me, I'll do it ((alone.)) As soon as we get to the Cradle, I'm hunting down Vela - with or ((without)) you.
Chinese: 好吧,你若不肯帮我,我就((独自))去干。一踏上摇篮,我就去找薇拉算账——不管有没有((你))。

English: <<She smiles slightly.>> I'm glad you've had a change of heart, Confessor. What changed your mind? Being driven through by Vela's ((sword)), perhaps?
Chinese: <<她微微一笑。>>很高兴你回心转意了,忏悔者。什么让你改变了主意?是被薇拉的((剑))穿了个透,或许?

English: Regardless, I'm glad to have you backing me up. I was thinking I'd have to face Vela ((alone)), and that's not an easy prospect.
Chinese: 无论如何,很高兴有你支援。我本来还想着得((独自))面对薇拉,那可不是件轻松的事。

English: <<She smiles slightly.>> If anything would change your mind, it'd be ((that))...
Chinese: <<她微微一笑。>>若有什么能让你改变主意,那一定是((这个))……

English: Regardless, I'm glad to have you backing me up. I was thinking I'd have to face Vela ((alone,)) and that's not an easy prospect.
Chinese: 无论如何,很高兴有你支援。我本来还想着得((独自))面对薇拉,那可不是件轻松的事。

English: <<Orlaith is silent for a moment.>> ##You know... I've never felt like I've ((belonged)) anywhere. Being born from a glass tube'll do that to you.
Chinese: <<奥莱丝沉默了片刻。>>##你知道……我从未觉得自己((属于))任何地方。从玻璃管里出生,就会这样。

English: Even those first few years with Vela, when we thought we were really making a difference - it was still ((Vela's)) dream we were chasing, y'know?
Chinese: 就算是最初与薇拉同行的那几年,我们以为自己真的在改变世界——可我们追逐的终究还是((薇拉))的梦想,你懂吗?

English: But now... I think I finally know what my purpose is. To ((stop)) the evils of my ancestors from ever being repeated. <<She twists up the corner of her mouth.>> Or die trying.
Chinese: 但现在……我想我终于知道自己的使命了。((阻止))先祖的罪恶再度重演。<<她嘴角一歪。>>哪怕为此而死。

English: For better or worse, that's thanks to ((you,)) Confessor. So I s'pose, I just wanted to say... thank you.
Chinese: 无论好坏,这都要归功于((你)),忏悔者。所以我想说……谢谢你。

English: <<She smiles at you, warmly.>>
Chinese: <<她温暖地朝你微笑。>>

English: <<She smirks.>> Of course.
Chinese: <<她得意一笑。>>当然。

English: I've ((seen)) you fight. Vela doesn't stand a chance.
Chinese: 我((见识))过你的身手。薇拉毫无胜算。

English: I don't know, but all we can do is try our best.
Chinese: 我不知道,但我们能做的就是全力以赴。

English: Vela convinced me; I want to make her Heaven a reality.
Chinese: 薇拉说服了我;我想让她的天堂成为现实。

English: You're right; the time for talk is over. Do your worst.
Chinese: 你说得对;谈话的时间结束了。放手去干吧。

English: Just try not to ((kill)) her, okay?
Chinese: 只是尽量别((杀))了她,好吗?

English: Change of plans. I want to make her Heaven a reality.
Chinese: 计划有变。我想让她的天堂成为现实。

English: Yes, I want to see her Heaven made a reality.
Chinese: 是,我想看见她的天堂成为现实。

English: No, we should try and stop her.
Chinese: 不,我们应该设法拦住她。

English: That bitch stabbed me! She won't leave the Cradle alive.
Chinese: 那贱人捅了我!她别想活着离开摇篮。

English: My pleasure, Orlaith.
Chinese: 乐意效劳,奥莱丝。

English: We just need your sword skills, that's all.
Chinese: 我们只需要你的剑术,仅此而已。

English: It has been a pleasure, Confessor. I shall see you on stage.
Chinese: 与你同行是我的荣幸,忏悔者。舞台上见。

English: <<Frost is sipping from a teacup, which he raises in salute at your approach.>> ##Ah, Confessor! Good of you to join us.
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特正啜着茶,见你走近,举杯致意。>>##啊,忏悔者!欢迎入席。

English: So, here we are at last. The interval is nearly over. The curtain's soon to open. Everything is in place for the final act. ##Let's just hope I can remember my lines.
Chinese: 那么,我们终于到了。幕间休息即将结束。大幕即将拉开。终幕的一切都已就位。##只希望我还记得自己的台词。

English: <<He sips.>> Oh, naturally I'm scared ((shirt))less. This is the confrontation I've been running from all along. ((This)) what I became Horace to escape.
Chinese: <<他啜了一口。>>哦,我当然怕得((魂))飞魄散。这是我一直逃避的对峙。我化身霍勒斯就是为了逃离((这个))。

English: <<He sips.>> Nevertheless, a little stage fright is only natural. This is the confrontation I've been running from all along. ((This)) what I became Horace to escape.
Chinese: <<他啜了一口。>>尽管如此,有点怯场也再正常不过。这是我一直逃避的对峙。我化身霍勒斯就是为了逃离((这个))。

English: Yet I am finding that the fear is less... ((biting)) than before. It feels calming, somehow, to last be walking ((towards)) my troubles, with a firm resolve. ##<<He snorts.>> Funny how long we resist the simplest lessons.
Chinese: 但我发现这恐惧已不如从前那般……((刺骨)).不知怎的,带着坚定的决心,最终((迎着))麻烦走去,反而让人心定。##<<他哼了一声。>>有趣的是,最简单的道理我们偏偏抗拒最久。

English: Confessor, do you remember our first meeting? Lately I've found myself turning it over in my brain. ##At the time, you argued that we should use the power of the Angel to build a better world.
Chinese: 忏悔者,你还记得我们初次见面吗?近来我总在脑中反复回想那一刻。##当时,你主张我们应当借助天使之力,建设一个更美好的世界。

English: I was hesitant, of course. I scarcely trusted myself to choose a pair of curtains, let alone the fate of humanity.
Chinese: 我当时犹豫不决,自不必说。我连挑一对窗帘都不敢信自己,更别说人类的命运了。

English: But... ##<<He sighs, then looks into your eyes.>> I have come to the conclusion that you were right, and I was wrong.
Chinese: 但是……##<<他叹了口气,直视你的眼睛。>>我得出的结论是:你是对的,我错了。

English: Confessor, do you remember our first meeting? Lately I've found myself turning it over in my brain. ##At the time, you persuaded me that we should destroy the Angel, lest it obliterate the world.
Chinese: 忏悔者,你还记得我们初次见面吗?近来我总在脑中反复回想那一刻。##当时,你说服我应当毁掉天使,免得它毁灭世界。

English: It felt so ((liberating)) to agree with you. To finally shrug off the burden of my dreams, and let go of all those years I sacrificed for my homeland's impossible promise.
Chinese: 赞同你的感觉如此((解脱)).终于卸下梦想的重担,放下我为祖国的无稽承诺牺牲的岁月。

English: But... ##<<He sighs, then looks into your eyes.>> I have come to the conclusion that both of us were wrong.
Chinese: 但是……##<<他叹了口气,直视你的眼睛。>>我得出的结论是:我们俩都错了。

English: Confessor, do you remember our first meeting? Lately I've found myself turning it over in my brain. ##At the time, you persuaded me that the Angel's promise was a mirage; that a better world can only be built one brick at a time.
Chinese: 忏悔者,你还记得我们初次见面吗?近来我总在脑中反复回想那一刻。##当时,你说服我天使的承诺只是海市蜃楼;更美好的世界只能一砖一瓦地建造。

English: Those were wise words. The Dark Stars could have bettered ((so many)) lives with all the power and treasure we attained. If we'd done the hard work, and made the hard choices. Instead we took the easy path, following our leader into damnation for a prize that could absolve any crime.
Chinese: 那是明智之言。以我们获得的力量与财宝,黑星本可以改善((无数))人的生活。只要我们肯下苦功,肯做艰难抉择。而我们却走了捷径,追随首领坠入万劫不复,只为一个能赦免一切罪行的奖赏。

English: But... ##<<He takes a deep breath, and locks eyes with you.>> Things are different now. Don't you see? The Cradle has risen. The stable door has been blown off its ((bally)) hinges.
Chinese: 但是……##<<他深吸一口气,与你四目相对。>>现在情况不同了。你没看见吗?摇篮已经升空。马厩的门已经被炸离了((该死的))铰链。

English: Everything the Clockwork Kingdom ever tried was mere child's play compared to the Angel. This is ((it)); the real deal. And now that we're on the precipice... I find I cannot turn my back.
Chinese: 与天使相比,发条王国做过的一切都只是儿戏。这才是((真货));货真价实的。如今我们已立于悬崖边缘……我发现自己无法背过身去。

English: It's all Horace's fault, I'm afraid. His visions were so good because he still had hope. Hope that every person could be redeemed; that love really was more powerful than despair.
Chinese: 恐怕这都得怪霍勒斯。他的幻象之所以美好,是因为他还怀着希望。希望每个人都能得到救赎;希望爱真的比绝望更有力量。

English: When you reawakened my old self, that hope didn't die. It's stayed with me, infectious, all mixed up together with everything I've seen and done.
Chinese: 当你唤醒了昔日的我,那希望并未死去。它一直留在我身上,极富感染力,与我见过的一切、做过的一切混作一团。

English: <<Frost smiles ruefully.>> So you see, I have to believe that Horace wasn't wrong to hope. ##I mean that literally: I have no choice but to believe. For Sam, and my family, and everyone I've ever loved.
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特苦笑。>>所以你看,我不得不相信,霍勒斯抱有希望并没有错。##我是字面意义上的不得不信:我别无选择。为了萨姆,为了我的家人,为了我爱过的每一个人。

English: <<Frost smiles ruefully.>> So you see, I have to believe that Horace wasn't wrong to hope. ##I mean that literally: I have no choice but to believe.
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特苦笑。>>所以你看,我不得不相信,霍勒斯抱有希望并没有错。##我是字面意义上的不得不信:我别无选择。

English: <<Frost's smile widens.>> You mean it? ##Very well, then. Let us take our places for the performance of a lifetime.
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特笑容绽放。>>你是认真的?##那好。就让我们各就各位,上演一生一次的演出。

English: <<Frost gazes at you for a while, then nods, his expression surprisingly peaceful.>> ##Very well. If this final act should cast us as foes, let us play our parts with gusto.
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特凝视你片刻,然后点头,神情出奇地平静。>>##很好。若终幕把我们安排成对手,那就让我们酣畅淋漓地演好各自的戏份。

English: <<Frost laughs.>> Refreshingly honest, Confessor. Very well; you improvise, and I will react. If it transpires that we are cast as foes, let us play our parts with gusto.
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特大笑。>>难得的坦率,忏悔者。很好;你来即兴,我来接戏。若终幕把我们安排成对手,那就让我们酣畅淋漓地演好各自的戏份。

English: <<He sighs.>> I'm going to ((flipping)) regret all this, aren't I?
Chinese: <<他叹气。>>这一切我((早晚))会后悔的,对吧?

English: How are you feeling?
Chinese: 你感觉如何?

English: You'll do fine, Frost. After all, we've rehearsed plenty.
Chinese: 你会演好的,弗罗斯特。毕竟,我们排练得够多了。

English: If you're saying you want to activate the Angel, I'm with you.
Chinese: 你的意思是想启动天使,那我跟你站一边。

English: I'm sorry, Frost. I won't let you activate the Angel.
Chinese: 抱歉,弗罗斯特。我不会让你启动天使。

English: Honestly, I have no idea what I'll do once we reach the Angel.
Chinese: 说实话,到了天使跟前我该怎么办,我自己也没数。

English: Ever since we saw it, I've been thinking of that Angel. ## I've long read of such ominous entities, drifting in the Void beyond reality; but until now they were entirely ((theoretical)).
Chinese: 自从见过它,我就一直在想那位天使。##这样的不祥之物,我久有研读,说它们漂荡于现实之外的虚空;但直到如今,它们都纯属((理论))。

English: But seeing such a creature in the ((flesh?)) I could ((feel)) its... incongruity, its vast contradiction, like a thorn in my brain. With something so alien to this world, maybe Vela really ((can)) bend reality to her will...
Chinese: 但亲眼((目睹))这样一个造物,我能((感受))到它的……格格不入,它的巨大矛盾,像一根扎在我脑中的刺。有如此 alien 于这个世界的东西,或许薇拉真的((能))把现实扭成她想要的模样……

English: <<The Duchess plays idly with her Void dagger, watching it glide through the air.>> ##Oh, Confessor. My apologies, I was lost in thought...
Chinese: <<女公爵漫不经心地把玩着她的虚空匕首,看着它划过空气。>>##哦,忏悔者。抱歉,我陷入沉思了……

English: It's that ((Angel.)) I've long read of such entities, drifting in the Void beyond reality; but until now they were entirely ((theoretical)). For all the complexities of our cipher art, we have only the smallest understanding of the Void.
Chinese: 是那位((天使)).这样的存在,我久有研读,说它们漂荡于现实之外的虚空;但直到如今,它们都纯属((理论)).纵然我们的密文之术精深复杂,对虚空的理解却只有毫末。

English: But seeing such a creature in the ((flesh?)) I could ((feel)) its... incongruity, its vast contradiction, like a thorn in my brain. Not a single part of it was ever meant to intersect with this world.
Chinese: 但亲眼((目睹))这样一个造物,我能((感受))到它的……格格不入,它的巨大矛盾,像一根扎在我脑中的刺。它的每一寸都从未打算与这个世界相交。

English: That Vela succeeded in acquiring the creature is quite remarkable. Maybe she truly ((can)) achieve this audacious ((Heaven)) of hers.
Chinese: 薇拉竟能得到这造物,着实不凡。也许她真的((能))实现她那大胆的((天堂))。

English: Confessor, you told me that Vela could grant the Endless a true death, if her Heaven prevails. ##I've been thinking on this a great deal these past few days.
Chinese: 忏悔者,你告诉过我,若薇拉的天堂得胜,她能让无尽者获得真正的死亡。##这几天我一直在反复思索此事。

English: It's Ironic that her hunt for immortality could grant my people the dreamless slumber many of them crave. <<She smiles.>> Ironic, but not undesirable.
Chinese: 讽刺的是,她对永生的追逐,竟能赐予我的人民他们中许多人渴求的无梦长眠。<<她微笑。>>讽刺,却并不令人反感。

English: <<She closes her eyes.>> So many years of listless agony. So many lifetimes, flittered away in a half-life; unable to feel the air in our lungs, or the wind in our hair...
Chinese: <<她闭上眼睛。>>那么多年百无聊赖的煎熬。那么多辈子,在半死不活中虚度;感受不到肺中的空气,发间的风……

English: But... do you truly mean to aid Vela? Orlaith and Basalt, it seems, are set on opposing her.
Chinese: 可是……你当真要助薇拉?奥莱丝和巴索特看来铁了心要与她作对。

English: Confessor, you told me that Vela could grant the Endless a true immortality, if her Heaven prevails. ##I've been thinking on this a great deal these past few days.
Chinese: 忏悔者,你告诉过我,若薇拉的天堂得胜,她能让无尽者获得真正的永生。##这几天我一直在反复思索此事。

English: It has been many years since I've felt the air in my lungs or the wind in my hair, or... or seen my daughter's smile. To think that these things could be still be possible? ##I have come to realise that I... would like that very much.
Chinese: 我已经多少年没有感受过肺中的空气、发间的风,或者……或者看见我女儿的微笑了。想到这些居然还有可能?##我意识到,我……非常渴望那样。

English: But... do you truly mean to aid Vela? Orlaith and Basalt, it seems, are set on opposing her.
Chinese: 可是……你当真要助薇拉?奥莱丝和巴索特看来铁了心要与她作对。

English: Confessor, you told me that Vela must be stopped, and that us Endless must learn to accept our fate. ##I've been thinking on this a great deal these past few days.
Chinese: 忏悔者,你告诉过我,薇拉必须被阻止,而我们无尽者必须学会接受自己的命运。##这几天我一直在反复思索此事。

English: My people's burden is ours to bear, and though we lament our torment, I believe some good, no matter how slight, can be gleaned from the worst of tragedies.
Chinese: 我的人民的重担须由我们自己扛起,尽管我们哀叹自己的苦难,但我相信,哪怕再微小的善,也能从最悲惨的灾难中拾得。

English: Vela's idea of Heaven might benefit my people, but I have no doubt it would wreak great havoc and disruption upon everyone else. For this reason I'll help you to stop Vela, no matter the cost.
Chinese: 薇拉的天堂或许能惠及我的人民,但我毫不怀疑,它会给所有其他人带来巨大的浩劫与动荡。因此,无论代价如何,我都会帮你拦住薇拉。

English: ...you ((are)) still going to try and stop her, correct?
Chinese: ……你((还是))打算拦住她的,对吧?

English: <<She nods.>> I thought as much. It will be a risky fight, but I'll do my best to aid you.
Chinese: <<她点头。>>我就知道。这将是一场凶险的战斗,但我会尽力助你。

English: <<She looks away, and is silent for a moment.>> ##I... understand. Though I'm vexed you would stir such false hope in me, I see what's at stake here.
Chinese: <<她移开目光,沉默片刻。>>##我……明白了。虽然你撩起我这般虚假的希望,令我气恼,但我明白此地利害几何。

English: <<She frowns.>> My, you ((do)) have such fickle whims, Confessor. I had thought the matter settled.
Chinese: <<她皱眉。>>哎呀,你的心思可真((够))善变,忏悔者。我还以为这事已经定了。

English: I won't deny that there will be many... ((boons)) to the Endless, for assisting in Vela's plan. So, do as you see fit; I'll lend my ciper-sorcery to the cause, one way or another.
Chinese: 我不否认,协助薇拉的计划,会给无尽者带来许多……((好处)).那么,你自行斟酌;无论如何,我都会把我的密文魔法借予这番事业。

English: <<She nods.>> Thank you, Confessor. Together we will see this through.
Chinese: <<她点头。>>谢谢你,忏悔者。我们会一起把这事办成。

English: When we reach the Cradle, I'll keep Vela's main force distracted with a cipher-shield. That should give you time to find an alternate entrance.
Chinese: 到了摇篮,我会用一道密文护盾拖住薇拉的主力。这应该能给你时间另找入口。

English: But no matter what, this will be a perilous mission. I've spoken to Caer, and arranged for my daughter's hand to be delivered home if I am to... meet a ((similar)) fate to hers.
Chinese: 但无论如何,这将是一次凶险的任务。我已与凯尔谈过,并安排好,若我遭遇与她((相似))的命运,就把我女儿的手送回家。

English: After she ran me through with her blade, I'm hardly going to ((help)) her.
Chinese: 她用剑把我穿了个透之后,我可不太可能((帮))她。

English: Her so-called Heaven is too chaotic an idea; she must be stopped.
Chinese: 她那所谓的天堂太过混乱;必须拦住她。

English: Despite her actions, I will help her achieve this Heaven; for the benefit of all.
Chinese: 尽管她的所作所为,我仍会帮她实现这个天堂;为了众人的福祉。

English: Right, well despite it all, that went pretty smooth, eh? <<He grins.>> ##Damn sight better than the last landing, at least.
Chinese: 好了,不管怎么说,这一趟挺顺,嗯?<<他咧嘴笑。>>##至少比上次着陆强多了。

English: What's the plan now we're here?
Chinese: 到了这里,计划是什么?

English: I'll get going.
Chinese: 我这就出发。

English: We're aboard the most abhorrent vessel ever constructed, surrounded by the Union Navy; on our way to face ((Vela Callose)) and her captive eldritch horror.
Chinese: 我们正身处史上最可憎的飞行器之上,四面被联盟海军包围;此行是要去面对((薇拉·卡洛斯))和她囚禁的骇人恐怖。

English: <<She smiles.>> Careful, Confessor. Anything more dangerous and I might start having ((fun)).
Chinese: <<她微笑。>>小心点,忏悔者。再危险一点,我就要开始觉得((好玩))了。

English: Once more I've erected my [[transpositional supply tent]]. By all means use it to stock up, but don't tarry; we must strike quickly now that we're here.
Chinese: 我又一次立起了我的[[置换补给帐篷]].尽管用它补给,但别耽搁;既然已经到了,我们必须速战速决。

English: Vela's lackeys will come at us in full force, but I'll try to keep them at bay for as long as I can. ##Once we've set off you must [[find Frost]] and help him make his entrance.
Chinese: 薇拉的走狗会倾巢而出,但我会尽力把他们挡住,能挡多久是多久。##出发后你必须[[找到弗罗斯特]],帮他登场。

English: <<Frost is in full flow, seemingly possessed by the ghost of his piratical past.>> ##Onward, ladies! No dawdling, no dallying, and no ((fannying)) about! Last one to reach the [[aeration pipe]] owes us all a full Lundelese breakfast!
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特兴致高涨,仿佛被海盗时代的幽灵附体。>>##前进,女士们!不许磨蹭,不许偷懒,不许((磨洋工))!最后一个到达[[通气管道]]的,请我们全体吃一顿丰盛的伦德尔早餐!

English: <<He glances at you, baring his teeth in a fierce grin.>> ##Showtime, Confessor. Break a leg.
Chinese: <<他瞥你一眼,龇牙咧嘴地狞笑。>>##开演了,忏悔者。祝演出顺利。

English: The others are in position, Confessor - what are you waiting for? Find [[Caxton Frost]] and help him access the Cradle's interior.
Chinese: 其他人都就位了,忏悔者——你还等什么?去[[找卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特]],帮他进入摇篮内部。

English: What's taking [[Frost]] so long? We need to [[get this thing ((open))]], or it's all over!
Chinese: [[弗罗斯特]]怎么这么久?我们得[[把这家伙((弄开))]],不然全完了!

English: <<The Duchess is clearly straining to maintain her powerful cipher spell.>> ##Don't... worry about ((me))... Confessor! I've faced worse odds... than ((this)).
Chinese: <<女公爵明显在竭力维持她强大的密文咒法。>>##别……管((我))……忏悔者!我面对过比((这))更险的战局……

English: Just find [[Frost]]... and get ((inside)) this thing!
Chinese: 快去[[找弗罗斯特]]……钻进这家伙的((里面))!

English: <<Frost is once again fiddling with his handheld door-breaking device, but this time he is visibly under stress.>> ##Confessor! You've arrived in the nick of time. ((Confound)) these obstinate Emberians!
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特又在摆弄他的手持破门装置,但这次他明显压力很大。>>##忏悔者!你来得正是时候。((该死))的余烬人,怎么这么犟!

English: I am attempting to halt this aeration turbine to afford our ingress, but it appears there is a [[fail-safe switch]] somewhere nearby; most likely on the platform beneath here.##There's an [[elevator]] down nearby. Find that switch, shut it off, and you shall have your door.
Chinese: 我正尝试停住这台通气涡轮,好让我们进去,但附近某处似乎有一个[[保险开关]];多半在这下面的平台上。##附近有一部[[电梯]].找到那个开关,关掉它,你们就有门了。

English: <<Behind you there is a deafening shriek of offensive magic, and a flash of blue light that briefly casts deep shadows across Frost's face. He looks worried.>> ##Quickly now, Confessor! Let's not miss our cue!
Chinese: <<你身后传来震耳欲聋的攻击魔法尖啸,一道蓝光闪过,在弗罗斯特脸上投下深深的阴影。他看起来很担忧。>>##快点,忏悔者!可别误了我们的登场时机!

English: <<Frost's eyes are screwed tightly shut, and he no longer seems to hear anything you say.>> ##The Angel... please. You have to... nrggh. Sam? Sam...
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特双眼紧闭,似乎再也听不见你说的话。>>##天使……求你。你必须……嗯呃。萨姆?萨姆……

English: <<Frost's body lies mangled within the twisted wreckage of his clockwork armour, his fine clothes sodden with blood.>>
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特的躯体躺在他发条铠甲扭曲的残骸中,血肉模糊,华服浸透了鲜血。>>

English: Ah, ((fuck)).
Chinese: 啊,((他妈的))。

English: <<Frost tries to sit up as he cries out with surprising vehemence.>> No! ##<<A coughing fit overwhelms him.>>
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特挣扎着想坐起来,喊声大得惊人。>>不!##<<一阵咳嗽淹没了他。>>

English: <<He looks up at you.>> No. Don't stop for me. You must... hrrfff... reach Vela. Before it's too late.
Chinese: <<他抬头看你。>>不。别为我停下。你必须……呵……赶到薇拉那里。趁还来得及。

English: <<Frost grins weakly.>> No, I suppose you don't need a... hrff... a genius of natural philosophy... to tell you that I'm... nfff. Not long for this world.
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特虚弱地一笑。>>不,我想不需要一位……呵……自然哲学天才……来告诉你,我……嗯呋……在这个世界上时日无多了。

English: <<Frost gives you a weak but genuine grin, before coughing up blood.>> ##Hrfff. Heh. Go... go and fuck yourself, Confessor.
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特给你一个虚弱却真诚的笑容,随后咳出血来。>>##呵呋。嘿。去……去他妈的自己吧,忏悔者。

English: <<He grimaces.>> Not a... bad finish for old Caxton Frost, hm? A final stand. A heroic... hrrff... downfall. Not a d-dry eye... in the house. Dramatic... hrrfff... to the last.
Chinese: <<他龇牙咧嘴。>>对老卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特来说,这个……收场不算坏,嗯?最后一战。英勇的……呵……谢幕。满座……无一不落泪。戏剧性……呵……贯彻到底。

English: But... the c-curtain's not fallen yet, eh d-darling? If you can... build something better... out of all these ashes, then... nrrgh. Then it won't have been for nothing.
Chinese: 但是……大幕还没落下呢,对吧,亲……亲爱的?若你能……用这一片焦土……筑起更好的东西,那……嗯呃。这一切就不算白费。

English: <<He reaches up and grips your hand tightly.>> ##Please, C-confessor. Activate the Angel. Make all this... hrrrfff... worth a damn.
Chinese: <<他抬起手,紧紧抓住你的手。>>##求你了,忏……忏悔者。启动天使。让这一切……呵……有点价值。

English: <<He releases your hand and slumps back, his strength failing.>> ##Oh, and... please t-tell Sam... that I'm sorry. I really d-did want... nrgh... to come back to him.
Chinese: <<他松开你的手,向后倒下,力气渐渐流失。>>##哦,还有……请转告萨姆……对不起。我真的……嗯呃……真的很想……回到他身边。

English: <<He slumps back, his strength failing.>> ##Oh, and... please t-tell Sam... that I'm sorry. I really d-did want... nrgh... to come back to him.
Chinese: <<他向后倒下,力气渐渐流失。>>##哦,还有……请转告萨姆……对不起。我真的……嗯呃……真的很想……回到他身边。

English: Hang in there, Frost. I'll get you back to the cutter.
Chinese: 撑住,弗罗斯特。我会把你带回快艇。

English: I'm sorry, Frost. It doesn't look good.
Chinese: 对不起,弗罗斯特。情况不乐观。

English: You finally swore. I'm proud of you.
Chinese: 你终于骂人了。我为你骄傲。

English: I'll tell him. I promise.
Chinese: 我会告诉他的。我保证。

English: You can tell him yourself.
Chinese: 你可以亲口告诉他。

English: Looks like Frost has gotten that [[back door]] open. So what are you ((dallyin')) around here for?
Chinese: 看来弗罗斯特已经把那道[[后门]]弄开了。你还在这儿((磨蹭))什么?

English: Frost may be down, but we can't afford to dally. Get inside that [[pipe]] and find the [[Angel]] - for his sake!
Chinese: 弗罗斯特可能倒下了,但我们耽搁不起。钻进那条[[管道]],找到[[天使]]——为了他!

English: The Duchess may be down, but we can't afford to dally. Get inside that [[pipe]] and find the [[Angel]] - for her sake!
Chinese: 女公爵可能倒下了,但我们耽搁不起。钻进那条[[管道]],找到[[天使]]——为了她!

English: Our comrades may be down, but we can't afford to dally. Get inside that [[pipe]] and find the [[Angel]] - for their sake!
Chinese: 我们的同伴可能倒下了,但我们耽搁不起。钻进那条[[管道]],找到[[天使]]——为了他们!

English: <<Basalt stares at you, brows furrowed.>> Confessor...
Chinese: <<巴索特皱着眉盯着你。>>忏悔者……

English: If he's really passed, you can't ((think)) on it 'til we're done here. He knew the stakes and he chose to come anyways. Now keep your mind sharp and get back to it.
Chinese: 他若真走了,在办完这里的事之前,你((不许))想这些。他知道风险,却依然选择前来。现在打起精神,继续干活。

English: If he's really passed as well, you can't ((think)) on it 'til we're done here. He knew the stakes and he chose to come anyways. Now keep your mind sharp and get back to it.
Chinese: 他若也真走了,在办完这里的事之前,你((不许))想这些。他知道风险,却依然选择前来。现在打起精神,继续干活。

English: <<You hear Basalt mutter under his breath.>> ##Poor lad...
Chinese: <<你听见巴索特低声嘀咕。>>##可怜的孩子……

English: Hmph, the ((Duchess)), cut down? Things... must be real hairy out there.
Chinese: 哼,((女公爵))被砍倒了?外面……情形一定相当凶险。

English: Shit, the ((Duchess)) is down too? Things... must be real hairy out there.
Chinese: 该死,((女公爵))也倒了?外面……情形一定相当凶险。

English: But if anyone knows how to piece 'emselves back together, it'd be her. Just keep focused on the task at hand. ((Find Vela)).
Chinese: 但要说谁最懂得怎么把自己拼回去,那非她莫属。专心干手头的活。((找到薇拉))。

English: Frost is dead.
Chinese: 弗罗斯特死了。

English: The Duchess is... in pieces.
Chinese: 女公爵……碎成几块了。

English: I... you're right. I'll get going.
Chinese: 我……你说得对。我这就去。

English: Do not ((tarry)), Confessor. Find... Vela. Find the [[Angel]]. That... is all that matters now.
Chinese: 别再((耽搁))了,忏悔者。找到……薇拉。找到[[天使]]。如今……只有这最重要。

English: <<The Duchess has been hacked to pieces; you see parts of her body scattered across the floor, like the remnants of some gruesome festival.>>
Chinese: <<女公爵被砍成了碎块;你看见她身体的部件散落一地,宛如某场恐怖庆典的残余。>>

English: <<In response to your voice, a finger starts pointing wildly. You follow its gesture to a pile of bodily components, and you pull a jaw from within.>>
Chinese: <<回应你的声音,一根手指开始胡乱指划。你顺着它指的方向找到一堆身体部件,从中拉出一段下颚。>>

English: I'm sorry... Confessor. Couldn't... hold them all back...
Chinese: 对不起……忏悔者。没能……把他们都挡住……

English: Heh. Did you... bring your needle and thread? What a... pleasing image. ##Alas, I fear there's... no time for any such thing.
Chinese: 呵。你……带针线了吗?真是一幅……动人的画面。##可惜,恐怕没……时间了。

English: You'll do no such thing! No, Confessor, you... musn't make a fuss about me. There's simply... no time.
Chinese: 别做那种事!不,忏悔者,你……不必为我大动干戈。实在是……没时间了。

English: Quite right, Confessor. You musn't... make a fuss about me. I've been... fussed over enough for... ten lifetimes.
Chinese: 说得对,忏悔者。你不必……为我操心。我这辈子……被人操心的次数,已经够……十辈子用了。

English: I knew it would come to this, sooner or later. No doubt I... deserve it, after all that I've done. Perhaps it will even prove... an interesting change of pace, no?
Chinese: 我早知道迟早会有这一天。毫无疑问我……罪有应得,毕竟我做过那么多事。或许这还会是一段……有趣的插曲,不是吗?

English: Just... find [[Vela]], and that [[Angel]] of hers. ##Now ((go)), Confessor!
Chinese: 只要……找到[[薇拉]]和她那位[[天使]]。##现在((去吧)),忏悔者!

English: <<For a moment you are confused to discover a ((third)) hand - until you realise that she must have brought her daughter along with her.>>
Chinese: <<一时间,你困惑地发现一只((第三))只手——直到你意识到,她一定把女儿也带来了。>>

English: Hmm? What's... all this now? What are you doing? I... told you, there's no time to fuss!
Chinese: 嗯?这是……在做什么?你要干什么?我……说过了,没时间穷讲究!

English: <<The two hands touch, and shiver in surprise. Then, after a moment's pause, their fingers intertwine.>>
Chinese: <<两只手相触,惊喜地颤抖。片刻停顿之后,十指相扣。>>

English: <<Never before have you heard the Duchess's voice suffused with such feeling.>> ##Oh. ((Oh.)) My... darling. My petal. I've... I've got you. I've got you.
Chinese: <<你从未听过女公爵的声音里浸透着这样的深情。>>##哦。((哦。))我……亲爱的。我的花瓣。我……找到你了。找到你了。

English: Duchess? Can you... hear me?
Chinese: 女公爵?你能……听见我吗?

English: I'm sorry, Duchess...
Chinese: 对不起,女公爵……

English: Can we fix you?
Chinese: 我们能修好你吗?

English: I'll send for help...
Chinese: 我去搬救兵……

English: I'm sorry, but there's no time.
Chinese: 对不起,没时间了。

Chinese: <<[在女公爵的身体部件中翻找可能有用的东西。]>>

English: Goodbye, Duchess. Good luck.
Chinese: 再见,女公爵。祝你好运。

English: <<[Place her daughter's hand alongside one of hers.]>>
Chinese: <<[把她女儿的手放在她的一只手旁。]>>

English: <<As you approach the Angel a pressure builds inside your skull, until it feels like your head might split in twain. Your body shivers with a nauseating energy; somehow you know the Angel is ((inside)) you.>>
Chinese: <<当你接近天使,一股压力在你颅腔内积聚,直到你觉得脑袋要裂成两半。你的身体在一股令人作呕的能量中战栗;不知为何,你知道天使就在你((体内))。>>

English: <<A needle of pain gouges through your mind. Memories of your childhood, of people and places you knew, all flash before your eyes; wrenched forth by the will of this creature. Is it trying to ((understand)) you?>>
Chinese: <<一根疼痛之针剜过你的脑海。童年的记忆、你认识的人和去过的地方,尽数在眼前闪现;被这造物的意志生生拽出。它是在试图((理解))你吗?>>

English: <<More pain - but this time, the memories are not your own. A sensation of limitless possibility, of incomprehensible freedom and unending ((time)), envelops you.>>
Chinese: <<更多疼痛——但这一次,记忆不再属于你。一种无限可能、难以理解的自由与无尽((时间))的感觉将你包裹。>>

English: <<For just a fraction of a moment you understand what it means to be truly ((infinite)) - to stretch beyond the limits of this reality. You realise the Angel is trying to... ((share)) its experience with you, though much is lost in translation.>>
Chinese: <<就在一瞬之间,你懂得了真正((无限))意味着什么——延展到这个现实之外。你意识到天使正试图与你……((分享))它的体验,尽管许多东西在传递中散失。>>

English: <<A confusion of sensations flash through your mind. An Emberian vessel invading your life essence, somehow latching onto you; ((pulling)) you through layers of reality until you are small, oh so small, and trapped in this cage.>>
Chinese: <<纷乱的感觉掠过你的脑海。一艘余烬飞行器侵入你的生命本源,不知怎地攀附上你;((拖拽))着你穿过层层现实,直到你变得渺小,哦,如此渺小,被困在这牢笼之中。>>

English: <<You understand, somehow, that the Angel is severely impaired in this world. The limits of time and space, the ((rules)) inherent in such a rigid existence, entrap the Angel in this corporeal form.>>
Chinese: <<不知怎地,你明白天使在这个世界里严重受制。时间与空间的界限,这种僵硬存在所固有的((规则)),把天使困在这具躯壳之中。>>

English: <<What you know of the World Rend - scraps of history, hearsay, and a pervasive cultural dread - rises to the forefront of your mind.>>
Chinese: <<你对世界撕裂的了解——历史的残篇、道听途说,以及弥漫文化的恐惧——涌上你脑海的最前端。>>

English: <<A note of confusion flows through you. The Angel doesn't seem to be sure. But you understand that, when it was brought here, another tried to merge with it - ((unsuccessfully)).>>
Chinese: <<一丝困惑流经你身。天使似乎也不确定。但你明白,当它被带到此地时,曾有另一个存在试图与它融合——((未能成功))。>>

English: <<In that moment, a simple cry of pain from either of them could have obliterated this world; just as a human could accidentally trample on a colony of insects.>>
Chinese: <<在那一刻,它们中任何一方一声痛苦的哀鸣,都可能抹除这个世界;就像人类可能不小心踩死一窝昆虫。>>

English: <<Your body seethes with... ((impotence)) and impatience. Yes, you understand;  the Angel can do nothing on its own. Not in this reality, not in this ((body)): it is trapped here.>>
Chinese: <<你的身体涌动着……((无力))与焦躁。是的,你明白;天使自己什么都做不了。在这个现实里,在这具((躯壳))里:它被困于此。>>

English: <<It must merge with another - a sentient being from ((this)) material plane - if it is to have any agency here.>>
Chinese: <<它必须与另一个存在融合——来自((这个))物质位面的有感知的存在——才能在此有所作为。>>

English: <<It would need only be a moment, and the Angel could separate once more, peeling off from its new form and returning to the Void. ##Or it could stay, and weave a new reality within this one.>>
Chinese: <<只需一瞬,天使便可再度分离,从新的形态中剥落,回归虚空。##或者它也可以留下,在这个现实之内编织一个新的现实。>>

English: <<You see a corpse lowered into a grave - then a baby clawing its way out of the ((other side)) of the earth, covered in blood and placenta. To merge would be to die and be born anew.>>
Chinese: <<你看见一具尸体被放入坟墓——然后一个婴儿从大地的((另一侧))爬出,满身血污与胎衣。融合便是死去,而后新生。>>

English: <<Then you see wine being poured into a strange, serpentine vessel. When the glass breaks, the wine remains, keeping the shape. To merge would also change the Angel, endowing it with all your own quirks and values.
Chinese: <<接着你看见酒被倒入一个古怪的蛇形容器。玻璃碎了,酒却留存,保持着形状。融合也会改变天使,赋予它你的全部怪癖与价值观。

English: <<Flowers blossom and decay all at once. Clouds boil away and fatten and burst. A moth flaps its wings and towers fall; it flaps again and the towers have always stood proudly. Uncertainty: the Angel cannot say for sure what will become of your world.>>
Chinese: <<花朵同时绽放又凋零。云朵沸腾、增厚又爆裂。一只飞蛾扇动翅膀,高塔倾倒;它再度扇动,高塔又始终傲然矗立。不确定:天使无法断言你的世界将变成什么模样。>>

English: <<A sense of responsibility comes over you. You think this means... that ((you)) must be careful. If you merge, you will be as one; and the power you wield will be terrifying.>>
Chinese: <<一种责任感涌上你心头。你想,这意味着……((你))必须谨慎。若你融合,你们将合为一体;而你们掌握的力量将可怕至极。>>

English: <<You feel a yearning for something like home; for the expanse of the infinite Void. But a wave of anxiety hits you: there will be no going back from this decision.>>
Chinese: <<你感到一种对近似家园之物的渴望;对无限虚空之浩瀚的渴望。但一阵焦虑袭来:这个决定没有回头路。>>

English: <<All the pity and despair, the tumult and the blood; the cyclical cruelty, and the pious theft. All of it will go on, alongside whatever joy the people of the Skyrealms can carve from the crooked bough of mere existence. Is that your will?>>
Chinese: <<所有的怜悯与绝望,动荡与鲜血;循环往复的残酷,与假虔诚之名的掠夺。这一切都将延续,与天空领域的人们能从纯粹存在的扭曲枝干上刻出的每一分欢乐同在。这是你的意愿吗?>>

English: <<Your body is engulfed in a warm tingling that soon becomes a tearing, agonising pain. Your vision distorts, then seems to blend with your other senses; like your very consciousness is dissolving into water.>>
Chinese: <<你的身体被一阵温暖的酥麻吞没,旋即化作撕裂般的剧痛。你的视觉扭曲,继而似乎与其它感官融为一体;仿佛你的意识正溶解于水中。>>

English: <<The Angel is borrowing your mortal essence, so that it may leave this reality. Your last coherent thought is a desperate hope that you made the right choice.>>
Chinese: <<天使正借用你的凡人本质,以便离开这个现实。你最后一条连贯的思绪,是一个孤注一掷的愿望:愿你做出了正确的选择。>>

English: <<A soothing sensation engulfs you. The Angel waits patiently.>>
Chinese: <<一股抚慰的感觉将你吞没。天使耐心地等待着。>>

English: <<You feel a sense of opportunity; of excitement in the unknown, and of starting anew. But a surge of dread engulfs you: there will be no going back from this decision.>>
Chinese: <<你感到一种机遇之感;对未知的兴奋,与重新开始的悸动。但一阵恐惧将你吞没:这个决定没有回头路。>>

English: <<Even if humanity survives, will we recognise ourselves? And why should you be the one who chooses for them? Are you so just, so righteous, that you should set the pattern of their existence? Are you prepared to claim that power?>>
Chinese: <<就算人类幸存,我们还认得出自己吗?凭什么由你来替他们做选择?你难道如此公正、如此正义,竟要为他们设定存在的范式?你准备好攫取那份力量了吗?>>

English: <<Your body is engulfed in a warm tingling that soon becomes a tearing, agonising pain. Your vision distorts, then seems to blend with your other senses; like your very consciousness is dissolving into water.>>
Chinese: <<你的身体被一阵温暖的酥麻吞没,旋即化作撕裂般的剧痛。你的视觉扭曲,继而似乎与其它感官融为一体;仿佛你的意识正溶解于水中。>>

English: <<You are merging with the Angel, so that two become one. Your last coherent thought is a desperate hope that you made the right choice.>>
Chinese: <<你正与天使融合,二将合一。你最后一条连贯的思绪,是一个孤注一掷的愿望:愿你做出了正确的选择。>>

English: <<A soothing sensation engulfs you. The Angel waits patiently.>>
Chinese: <<一股抚慰的感觉将你吞没。天使耐心地等待着。>>

English: <<A warmth washes over you. The Angel waits for your query.>>
Chinese: <<一股暖意漫过你全身。天使等待着你的询问。>>

English: <<A sensation of calm. The Angel feels no sense of urgency, it seems. If only the same were true for you.>>
Chinese: <<一种平静的感觉。天使似乎毫无紧迫感。但愿你也能如此。>>

English: <<A tingling of anticipation suffuses your body. The Angel awaits your decision.>>
Chinese: <<一阵期待的酥麻遍布你的身体。天使等待着你的决定。>>

Chinese: 你本该((死))了。我把剑捅进你的心脏,我亲眼看着你倒下。除非有((神))出手,才能拦住你不——

English: You... ((killed)) Orlaith?
Chinese: 你……((杀))了奥莱丝?

English: She attacked me; I had no ((choice)). And if it wasn't for ((you))...
Chinese: 她攻击我;我别无((选择)).而且若不是((你))……

English: What's happened to your arm? Your ((face))?
Chinese: 你的手臂怎么了?你的((脸))?

English: <<She flexes her arm, its black flesh pulsing with eldritch energy.>> ##Merely a byproduct of the ((unprecedented)) work we have been doing here.
Chinese: <<她弯曲手臂,漆黑的血肉中脉动着诡异的能量。>>##不过是我们在此进行的((史无前例))工作的副产品罢了。

English: Vela, let's ((talk)) about this...
Chinese: 薇拉,我们((谈谈))吧……

English: No more ((talk)), Confessor. Not after everything you've done.
Chinese: 别再((谈))了,忏悔者。在你做过这一切之后,免谈。

English: In the name of the Inquisition, I will cut you down.
Chinese: 以宗教裁判所之名,我会砍倒你。

English: If a fight is what you want, I will ((gladly)) give it.
Chinese: 你若想要一场战斗,我((乐意奉陪))。

English: ((You)) turned my comrades against me, forcing my hand. Their blood is on ((your)) conscience as much as my own.
Chinese: ((你))挑拨我的同伴与我为敌,逼我出手。他们的血,((你))的良心和我的一样,都洗不净。

English: They abandoned your cause long ago, Vela.
Chinese: 他们早就背弃你的事业了,薇拉。

English: <<She scoffs.>> They were just afraid of real change. None of them tried to ((assassinate)) me until you showed up.
Chinese: <<她嗤笑。>>他们只是害怕真正的改变。在你出现之前,可没有一个想((刺杀))我。

Chinese: 你就不能用你那位天使((把他们救回来))吗?

English: If you had only let me ((help)) you...
Chinese: 你当初若肯让我((帮))你……

English: <<Vela snarls.>> Oh yes! If I'd only stayed in the ((Navy)) like a good little girl. If I'd only done what I was ((told)). If, if, ((if!))
Chinese: <<薇拉咆哮。>>哦是啊!我要是乖乖待在((海军))里该多好。我要是乖乖听((话))该多好。如果,如果,((如果!))

English: <<She points her sword at you, Orlaith's blood still dripping from it.>> ##Get ready, Confessor. I won't let ((you)) nor the Inquisition get in the way of what comes next - for the sake of ((humanity)).
Chinese: <<她用剑指着你,奥莱丝的血还在剑上滴落。>>##准备好,忏悔者。我绝不允许((你)),也不允许宗教裁判所,阻拦接下来的一切——为了((人类))。

English: En garde!
Chinese: 看剑!

English: So be it.
Chinese: 那便如此。

English: Don't you mean for the sake of ((Isabet)), your sister? That's what this is ((really)) about.
Chinese: 你不该说是为了((伊莎贝特)),你妹妹吗?这才是这一切的((真正))原因。

English: <<Vela glares at you with a newfound fury.>> How ((dare)) you mention her name! You know ((nothing)) of her soul - of my ((family)).
Chinese: <<薇拉带着前所未有的怒火瞪着你。>>你((怎敢))提起她的名字!你对她的灵魂((一无所知))——对我的((家人))一无所知。

English: Isabet was... she meant more to me than... ##<<Vela closes her eyes for a long moment.>>
Chinese: 伊莎贝特她……她对我而言,比……##<<薇拉闭了很久的眼睛。>>

English: Isabet and my mother ((burned alive)) in my father's mansion. That Isabet was taken so young, and I alone should live, speaks plainly of the injustice of this world. I won't ((apologise)) for wanting to change that.
Chinese: 伊莎贝特和我母亲在我父亲的宅邸里((被活活烧死)).伊莎贝特那么年轻就殒命,而我独独活了下来,这明明白白诉说着这个世界的不公。想改变这一切,我((不会道歉))。

English: What of the people who suffered for your vision? People like Caer, who you left to ((die))?
Chinese: 那些为你的愿景受苦的人呢?像凯尔那样被你弃之((等死))的人?

English: <<Vela stutters, now stumbling over her words.>> Caer... ((betrayed)) me. I... I would have given my ((life)) for that girl, but she... She...
Chinese: <<薇拉结巴起来,话语磕磕绊绊。>>凯尔……((背叛))了我。我……我本可以为那个女孩献出((生命)),可她……她……

English: @@ And now here you are, surrounded by the corpses of your ((new)) family. Was it worth it? Was Orlaith's death ((just?))
Chinese: @@而如今你在这里,被你((新))家人的尸体包围。值得吗?奥莱丝的死((公道吗?))

English: %% <<Vela stutters.>> I... they... They betrayed ((me!)) If only they had ((listened)), instead of... instead of... ##I didn't ((want)) to kill her. I... only meant to...
Chinese: %%<<薇拉结巴。>>我……他们……他们背叛了((我!))要是他们肯((听我的)),而不是……而不是……##我没((想))杀她。我……只是想……

English: && <<Vela's eyes go wide with shock - then narrow into slits of pure molten fury.>> ##I gave her the chance to stand down. I would have ((forgiven)) her. A privilege I will ((not)) grant ((you)).
Chinese: &&<<薇拉的双眼因震惊而睁大——随即眯成两条熔化的怒火。>>##我给过她停手的机会。我本会((原谅))她。这份优待,我((不会))给((你))。

English: Forget it. We'll finish this with our weapons.
Chinese: 算了。我们用武器来了结这一切。

English: <<Vela's sword drops from her hands and clatters on the floor. Tears stream from her eyes, though she betrays not a sob.>>
Chinese: <<薇拉的剑从她手中滑落,哐当砸在地板上。泪水从她眼中涌出,她却没发出一丝呜咽。>>

English: That's... what I always say, isn't it? 'I didn't want to'. 'They made me do it'. 'I had no choice'. ##<<She turns her gaze to the ceiling, blinking away tears.>> ((Damn)) you, Confessor...
Chinese: 这就是……我一直说的话,不是吗?"我不想这样"。"是他们逼我的"。"我别无选择"。##<<她把目光转向天花板,眨去泪水。>>((该死))的你,忏悔者……

English: Do you... have any ((idea)) how long ((never)) is? Never to see my sister again. Never to hear her stupid little laugh. ##Godsdamnit, all I ((ever)) wanted - <<She screws up her eyes.>>
Chinese: 你……((知道))((永远))有多长吗?再也见不到我妹妹。再也听不到她那傻乎乎的小笑声。##神啊,我((从来))只想——<<她眯紧双眼。>>

English: When I found that map it was like a fucking ((Djinn)) had answered my wish. Do you understand? Like a message from the universe, saying: maybe she died so I could save ((everyone)).
Chinese: 当我找到那张地图,就像一个该死的((灯神))应了我的愿。你明白吗?像宇宙捎来的口信,说:也许她死了,就是为了让我能拯救((所有人))。

English: And at every step since then, I've made the same choice. Every principle twisted. Every dead friend. The Angel could make it right. ##So my debt kept growing, and growing, until...
Chinese: 从那之后的每一步,我都做了同样的选择。扭曲每一条原则。失去每一位挚友。天使能把它纠正过来。##于是我的债越欠越多,越欠越多,直到……

English: <<Vela is silent for a long time. When she turns back to you it is with a despairing smile, her voice cracking with the desperate abandon of confession.>> ##I am so deep in blood that I can't even see the surface anymore.
Chinese: <<薇拉沉默良久。当她转回身面对你时,带着一个绝望的微笑,声音因孤注一掷的忏悔而破裂。>>##我陷在血里太深,连水面都看不见了。

English: <<Vela gestures hopelessly at the Angel.>> So you win, Confessor, the Angel will answer to the first mortal who speaks with it. If you think me a fool, then ((destroy)) it.
Chinese: <<薇拉朝天使无力地一挥手。>>所以你赢了,忏悔者,天使会回应第一个与它交谈的凡人。你若觉得我是傻瓜,那就((毁掉))它。

English: Just... whatever you do, do it ((quickly)). Before I change my mind again.
Chinese: 只是……无论你做什么,((快点))做。趁我还没再次改变主意。

English: Thank you, Vela.
Chinese: 谢谢你,薇拉。

English: ((Just nod and leave.))
Chinese: ((只是点头,然后离开。))

English: <<Vela wheezes and coughs, blood dribbling from her lips.>> ##It seems... I'm not the swordswoman... I used to be.
Chinese: <<薇拉喘息咳嗽,鲜血从唇边滴落。>>##看来……我已经不是当年那个……剑客了。

English: <<She grins weakly, showing teeth glazed in red.>> I guess it's up to ((you)) now, Confessor. The Angel... awaits.
Chinese: <<她虚弱地咧嘴,露出染红的牙齿。>>我想现在就看((你))的了,忏悔者。天使……在等着。

English: Just consider... what I said. You could ((use)) it... to... ((save)) this broken world...
Chinese: 只要想想……我说的话。你可以((用))它……来……((拯救))这个破碎的世界……

English: <<Vela breaks into more coughing, straining to keep herself upright.>>
Chinese: <<薇拉又咳嗽起来,竭力撑住身体。>>

English: What's this - ((you)) again?
Chinese: 这是怎么了——((又是))你?

English: That damned ((death god))! When I'm done with you, I will cut off its ((head))!
Chinese: 那该死的((死神))!等收拾完你,我就去砍了它的((脑袋))!

English: <<Vela cradles Orlaith in her arms as her body shakes with silent sobs, tears flowing down her cheeks.>>
Chinese: <<薇拉把奥莱丝搂在怀中,身体因无声的啜泣而颤抖,泪水顺着她的脸颊流下。>>

English: <<She looks up at you with red eyes, all too human after all.>> ##So it's ((you)). Funny... I would've thought a sword through the heart would've proven more of a ((setback)).
Chinese: <<她红着眼睛抬头看你,终究还是如此有血有肉。>>##原来是((你)).真有趣……我还以为一剑穿心会让人更加((一蹶不振))呢。

English: I had help from a ((friend)) of yours.
Chinese: 我得了你一位((朋友))的帮助。

English: I should've known you'd find ((that)) one. Quite the boon... ##<<She smiles weakly.>> Union don't know what they're missing.
Chinese: 我早该料到你会找到((那))一位。真是难得的助力……##<<她虚弱地一笑。>>联盟可不知道他们错过了什么。

English: I'm full of surprises.
Chinese: 我浑身都是惊喜。

English: Aren't you just, Confessor.
Chinese: 可不是嘛,忏悔者。

English: I... didn't want to kill her, you know. She came at me full force. I... only meant to disarm...
Chinese: 我……不想杀她的,你知道吗。她是全力扑向我。我……本只想缴她的械……

English: <<Vela closes her eyes, overwhelmed by a deep exhaustion.>> ##That's what I always say, isn't it? 'I didn't want to'. 'They made me do it'. 'I had no choice'.
Chinese: <<薇拉闭上眼睛,被深深的疲惫吞没。>>##这就是我一直说的话,不是吗?"我不想这样"。"是他们逼我的"。"我别无选择"。

English: You were right, I think. About me and Isabet. I wasn't chasing this dream for anyone but ((myself)). For that mute, stunned little girl, standing in the ashes of her home.
Chinese: 我想你是对的。关于我和伊莎贝特。我追逐这个梦想,从来不是为了别人,只是为了((我自己)).为了那个站在家园灰烬里、哑然失声的小女孩。

English: Do you have any ((idea)) how long ((never)) is? Never to see her again. Never to hear her stupid little laugh. ((Never.)) ##Truly, I don't know if ((anyone)) ever comes to terms with that.
Chinese: 你((知道))((永远))有多长吗?再也见不到她。再也听不到她那傻乎乎的小笑声。((永远)).##说真的,我不知道((有谁))能真正与此和解。

English: So I sailed around, pretending to be a saviour. Loosing my anger on whoever would play the villain. ##When I found that map... gods,  it was like a fucking ((Djinn)) granted my wish. Like a message from the universe, saying: maybe she died so you could do ((this)).
Chinese: 于是我四处航行,假装自己是救世主。把怒火倾泻在每一个肯当反派的人身上。##当我找到那张地图……神啊,就像一个该死的((灯神))实现了我的愿望。像宇宙捎来的口信,说:也许她死了,就是为了让你能做((这件事))。

English: Because really, who could dispute that logic? What price could outweigh saving everyone, forever? ##<<She shakes her head.>> Even Jack knew better than to gamble on credit.
Chinese: 说真的,谁能反驳这种逻辑?什么代价能大过永远拯救所有人?##<<她摇头。>>就连杰克都懂得不该赊账赌博。

English: The more principles I twisted, the more blood I spilled, the more ((friends)) I led to their deaths... the more my debt grew. And the more the Angel seemed like the ((only)) solution.
Chinese: 我扭曲的原则越多,洒下的血越多,带去送死的((朋友))越多……我的债就越深。而天使就越像是((唯一))的解法。

English: <<Vela meets your gaze again, eyes welling up, voice cracking with the desperate abandon of confession.>> ##So ((I)) can't be the one to make this choice. Not anymore. I am so deep in blood that I can't even see the surface.
Chinese: <<薇拉再度迎上你的目光,眼眶湿润,声音因孤注一掷的忏悔而破裂。>>##所以((我))不能是做这个选择的人。再也不能。我陷在血里太深,连水面都看不见了。

English: <<She lets her head fall to Orlaith's body again.>> Please. Go to the Angel. It'll answer to you. If you wish to ((destroy)) it, I won't stop you.
Chinese: <<她再次把头垂落在奥莱丝的躯体上。>>求你。去找天使吧。它会回应你。你若想((毁掉))它,我不会阻拦。

English: Thank you, Vela.
Chinese: 谢谢你,薇拉。

English: You're a prisoner of the Inquisition, now.
Chinese: 你现在是宗教裁判所的囚犯。

English: <<Vela says nothing as she rocks her best friend back and forth like a baby, wracked every now and then by spasms of grief.>>
Chinese: <<薇拉一言不发,像摇晃婴儿一样前后摇着她最好的朋友,不时被悲痛的痉挛击中。>>
